sections.text: This is an optional boss Closest Site of Grace: Subterranean Inquisition Chamber Multiplayer is allowed for this boss You can summon Spirit Ashes for this boss

sections.heading: Elden Ring Abductor Virgins Location
sections.text: The Abductor Virgins guard a passageway between Volcano Manor and Altus Plateau . From the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber Site of Grace, jump along the pillars to the south and enter a cave. At the end of the cave, the floor will give out and drop you to a lower level. Continue southwards and you'll reach the boss door for the Abductor Virgins. Map Link There are two ways to reach the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber Site of Grace: From Raya Lucaria Academy From the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace in Raya Lucaria Academy , head west out the door and around the corner. Ride the looping elevator down to the lower floor where you'll see a normal enemy Abductor Virgin . Let it grab you (use a Sacrificial Twig or Twiggy Cracked Tear to avoid losing runes), and you'll be teleported to a special area in Volcano Manor . Hop across the lava flows and travel southeast, dropping down a few ledges along a lava waterfall until you reach the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber Site of Grace. From Volcano Manor Head west out the door from the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, down the stairs, and along the southern edge of the stone platform until you reach a corpse hanging over the side. Walk to the north side of the platform directly opposite this corpse and carefully drop to the rocky platform far below. From there, hop across the lava flows and travel southeast, dropping down a few ledges along a lava waterfall until you reach the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber Site of Grace.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Abductor Virgins Boss Guide
sections.text: Abductor Virgins Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Abductor Virgins: Use the Lone Wolf Ashes Ash Summons Use items with Lightning Use Glintstone Shard Great / Swift Spell Bring Rune Arc Item Suggested weapons: Dragon Halberd (STR/DEX) Note: It's possible to cheese this boss by standing on an outcropped ledge where the bosses cannot hit you. Takes extra stance damage from lightning damage. 5 casts of Thunderboltare sufficient to stance break them, but repeated casts are unlikely to hit the innards as the head usually blocks the innards from the thunderbolt. Melee Users Due to there being two Abductor Virgins in the boss arena, the use of spirit ashes/ multiplayer summons is recommended, as splitting them apart makes the fight significantly easier. The wheel abductor should be killed first, due to its higher mobility and stronger move set. Additionally, the scythe abductor is easier to dodge in the 2 vs. 1 that the wheel version, so he should be your priority. Be careful not to get stuck on any things in the arena or give them an opportunity to both pin you at the same time. Attacking the abductors from behind is a good strategy as it prevents them from easier opening and grabbing you, which deals huge amounts of damage possibly outright killing the player. However, attacking an open abductor from the front deals additional damage, providing you are willing to take the risk. The idea is to bait one of them at a time towards you focusing on clearing one at a time as well. Most attacks can also be blocked with a shield when you are overwhelmed. If you manage to keep avoiding, reposition behind to get a few combo hits in order to stagger them. Magic and Ranged Users Because of the arena size and the fact that there are double of them, ranged combat is not recommended however should you choose to deal with them in ranged combat, having a spirit summon will help a lot to split up the duo in order to focus on clearing one at a time. Like the melee strategy, ideally clear the wheel variant because of its shorter range and limited moveset. You will need to keep circling around the arena in order to not get caught in a corner and have them both trap you to the edge. Be mindful of the objects that could also get you stuck in this location. If using spells, use Glintstone Shard for quick attacks. Keep dodging back and circling around for a better angle and use your ranged attack in between each of his dealt attacks. Dodge away from any dashes. It is possible to cheese this boss by standing on a ledge on top of a rock formation. From where you enter the boss arena, go toward the right and there should be a ledge high up that you could jump up to using other rocks. From here, the bosses have difficulty hitting you. The sickle abductor virgin can still hit you with a long throw, but such attack is easily dodged. From the ledge, you can fire away ranged attack such as sorcery or projectiles. Abductor Virgins Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Wheel Abductor Claws (Grab) Opens up its doors and quickly closes the distance in order to grab the unsuspecting target. Attempt to roll back and not get pinned by this attack, if it does manage to grab you, you can mash out to get released sooner to reduce damage Charge Dashes towards you, touching the wheels will cause damage. Dodge roll away before its follow up attack. This action can also be blocked with a shield. Wheel Uppercut Uses its wheel limb to deliver an uppercut. Block or Dodge this action. Swinging Sickle Abductor Claws (Grab) Like the Wheel version, this enemy quickly closes separation in order to open up its contraptions revealing reaching claws this can reach or grab. Attempt to roll back and not get pinned by this attack, if it does manage to grab you, you can mash out to get released sooner to reduce damage Sickle Rotate It begins to swing the sickle on its chains and rotate them 360 Roll through the direction of the swing to avoid damage or back away from the action area. Sickle Throw Extends its chains to throw a sickle Block this attack or roll forward through it to gain a better position for your next attack. Abductor Virgins Notes & Other Trivia Getting to this Boss via Patches' Raya Lucaria recommendation and returning to him before he moves to Mt. Gelmir will reward you with the Calm Down gesture , if you have not already received it.

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Abductor Virgins
sections.text: Ghiza's Wheel Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss. The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins. Inquisitor's Girandole Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir. Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conceived by a thorough mind.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Adan, Thief of Fire Boss Guide
sections.text: Adan, Thief of Fire Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Adan, Thief of Fire Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Adan, Thief of Fire: Magic Glintblade can be used to bait out his rolls, but otherwise any spell can work against him. Equip the Flamedrake Talisman found in the Groveside Cave to reduce Fire Damage taken. Melee Users The biggest challenge for melee players is keeping out of range of Adan's fire spells. Always watch out for the telegraphs. Each fire spell he uses flashes a red circular rune briefly before they are cast, signaling when you should dodge away. His Flame of the Fell God spell has a very long animation and slow travel speed, allowing you to easily maintain a safe distance. Catch Flame, on the other hand comes out very quickly and players will need to be extra vigilant in looking for the telegraph. Adan's melee attacks aren't anything special, although they do apply the hemorrhage effect. His flail combo has a very long animation and Adan commits to it fully if you are just out of range. It also has low tracking. Use this to your advantage and wait just out of reach for him to whiff the combo finisher before punishing. He is very easily stunned by heavy weapons, if he is stunned, follow up with 1 or 2 attacks. Magic and Ranged Users Adan poses no significant challenge for Magic and Ranged users as they can remain at a distance and avoid most of his attacks. During his Flame of the Fell God casting animation, Magic and Ranged have a huge advantage as they can pummel him with spells from afar. Do watch out for his dodge rolls, however. He uses these to close the distance and often follows up with an overhead smash. He will also end his flail combo early to dodge roll if necessary. Adan, Thief of Fire Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Flame of the Fell God Adan raises his left hand, summoning an orb of fire that then travels slowly towards a destination before exploding and setting fire to the ground. Has a large radius and deals massive damage on a direct hit. The attack has a very clear telegraph and long cast animation. Easily avoided by keeping your distance. Catch Flame Adan releases a burst of flame directly in front of him. This is usually used when in melee range. The attack comes out very quickly but is telegraphed by a red circular rune. Dodge backwards or to the side when you see the rune form. Overhead Swing Adan swings his flail downwards, smashing directly in front of him. Often used following a dodge roll. Dodge sideways. Wild Strikes Adan swings his flail wildly from side to side 7 times and then finishes off with a spinning strike. Easily exploited. Adan does not stop once he begins this animation if you remain just out of reach. Keep your distance and consider using Impaling Thrust, or other heavy attacks, when his combo finishes. Adan, Thief of Fire Notes & Other Trivia According to the spell he drops, he apparently stole the knowledge of the Flame of the Fell God incantation from Chief Guardian Arghanthy in the Mountaintops of the Giants. This explains how he is able to use it in combat. The Monks chased him to the land of Liurnia, which explains their presence in the area.

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Adan, Thief of Fire
sections.text: Monk's Flameblade Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. ' Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire. Fire Monk Hood Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with flames. Attire of the Fire Monks. The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of the Giants. Flame of the Fell God This legendary incantation is one of several that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants. Releases a ball of raging fire said to be inhabited by a fell god. The fireball floats toward enemies and explodes, setting the area ablaze. Arghanthy, the chief guardian of the Flame, had kept this incantation a well-kept secret until it was stolen by Adan. The fell god still lurks within the Fire Giants.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader Boss Guide
sections.text: Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader: Use Glintblade Phalanx or Carian Phalanx to quickly bring down her Poise . Use Ash of War: Giant Hunt to stunlock her. Her Imbued Helmsplitter attack has a short tracking distance, so start sprinting away immediately as she crouches down to jump. Don't overextend or you'll be stuck in an attack or cast animation and unable to react in time. Melee Users Dodge and Punish: Dodge, duck, dive, and dip is the strategy here. You simply cannot block her attacks as they are too quick and deadly, and Barricade Shield is useless, so you must dodge. Try to keep enough distance that you can run away as soon as you see her winding up Imbued Helmsplitter, which can easily one-shot you if it hits. Keep dodging until she does Helmsplitter or Knife Sweep, and punish her while she's recovering. These are your best openings to attack safely unless you're wielding a large enough weapon to stun her. Helmsplitter is also good opportunity to get a backstab, but note that the bowl-like nature of the arena means that there's a very small chance your backstab won't connect due to elevation differences. You can safely heal instead of punishing a slow attack, or just after dodging a Blade of Death. Glintblade Criticals: You can use the Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx to greatly increase pressure on her Poise. Unassisted, it can take four casts to get her staggered, but you can speed this up a lot by getting your own hits in as well. Keep in mind that she can sometimes collide with some of your Glintblades before they launch and then get get knocked back out of stagger once the rest fire. She'll recover quickly, so don't close in for a punish if this happens. Giant Hunt: Alecto is extremely weak against the Ash of War: Giant Hunt skill, as it not only deals huge bursts of poise damage, but every successful hit launches her into the air, meaning she has to get back up and is completely unable to move or attack while doing so. If you stagger your uses of Giant Hunt such that you hit her while she is getting back to her feet from the previous use, you can effectively stunlock her indefinitely. If she escapes the stunlock, simply dodge her attacks until she uses either of her Helmsplitter attacks, which have significant ending animations and give you prime openings to begin the cycle all over again. Poke Her To Death: Strength builds can make good use of weapons with a fast jab attack (like the Greatsword 's crouching/rolling light attack) to punish her while she's closing in for an attack. If you manage to stun her with the first attack, follow up with a second light attack - if she rolls away, stop swinging and back away while your stamina recharges. Storm Approaching : Quality and Dexterity builds can use Ash of War: Stormcaller for example on Grave Scythe and cast Bloodflame Blade on it to deal additional fire damage. Spinning attacks itself will knock the boss down which would allow you to regain HP and FP. Just don't forget to put on multi-hit (and Enraged Divine Beast if you have access to DLC) talismans to boost the damage. Parries and Backstabs : Most of Alecto's melee attacks are parriable. Take some runs to focus on observing her movesets and get accustomised to the speed of the fight. Quality & Dex builds can use a weapon with high critical damage (the Misericorde is a good choice). Equip the Dagger Talisman for a damage boosts and/or the Assassin's Crimson Dagger for HP regain. Equip a shield with the Golden Parry Ash of War to extend the parry range, or use the Carian Retaliation Ash of War on a small shield to parry the Death-Imbued Flame projectiles for some extra damage. Many of the Twist Sweep attacks and Jump attack (no flame) can be easily outrun and allow you to go in for backstabs. If you misread a combo or missed a parry earlier in her attack chain, roll to iframe next attacks and wait for the next opportunity. Rolling into her with the Briar set on will easily stuns/interrupts her attacks. Magic and Ranged Users Critical Hits: This is a formidable boss which often requires lots of HP and FP, so it's recommended to have at minimum 25 Vigor, 20 Mind, and 10-12 flasks. For Sorcery users, it's best to use multi-hit spells with homing capabilities such as Glintblade Phalanx or Carian Phalanx . These fire-and-forget spells allow you to focus on dodging Alecto's swift and powerful attacks. You can use Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx on your weapon for quick access. Maintain your distance and wait for openings and breaks between her attacks to cast your spells and then prepare to dodge her upcoming onslaught. While these spells are not particularly damaging to Alecto, they deal massive damage to her Poise, allowing you to get a critical attack in. Keep up this strategy throughout the whole fight and you should be able to bring her down. Sweeping Attacks: When Alect

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader
sections.text: Black Knife Tiche Ashes Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Black Knife Tiche. Tiche was one of the assassins who, on the night of the plot, ' imbued her black knife with the Rune of Death and slew Godwyn ' the Golden. She was the daughter of the Black Knife Ringleader, ' Alecto, and was killed protecting her mother during their flight ' from the royal capital. Black Knife Armor Scale armor used by the Black Knife Assassins, forged to make no sound. Traces of power yet remain in its concealing veil, which muffles the sound of footsteps. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself. Black Knife Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives. A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death. Concealing Veil Talisman put together from dark cloth with a lustrous sheen. Completely conceals the wearer's presence while crouching at a distance from foes. Part of one of the concealing veils used by the assassins on the Night of Black Knives. Black Knifeprint On the Night of the Black Knives, someone stole a fragment of Death from Maliketh, the Black Blade, and imbued its power into the assassins' daggers. This mark is evidence of the ritual, and hides the truth of the conspiracy. Maliketh's Black Blade Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again. Assassin's Crimson Dagger An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in crimson. Critical hits restore HP. This charm is modelled after the darkly gleaming blades used in the Night of Black Knives. Those which gave the demigods their first taste of death. Assassin's Cerulean Dagger An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in cerulean. Critical hits restore FP. This charm is modelled after the darkly gleaming blades used in the Night of Black Knives. Those which gave the demigods their first taste of death. Cursemark of Death Cursemark carved into the discarded flesh of Ranni the Witch. Also known as the half-wheel wound of the centipede. This cursemark was carved at the moment of Death of the first demigod, and should have taken the shape of a circle. However, two demigods perished at the same time, breaking the cursemark into two half-wheels. Ranni was the first of the demigods whose flesh perished, while the Prince of Death perished in soul alone.

sections.heading: Dialogue Related to Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader
sections.text: Ranni the Witch I stole a fragment of the Rune of Death, and used it to forge the godslaying black knives through fearsome rite. I did it all. Sorcerer Rogier They say the assassins who carried out the deed were scions of the Eternal City. A group entirely of women, arrayed in armour of silver under cloaks which fooled the eye.

Equip a shield with the Golden Parry Ash of War to extend the parry range, or use the Carian Retaliation Ash of War on a small shield to parry the Death-Imbued Flame projectiles for some extra damage. Many of the Twist Sweep attacks and Jump attack (no flame) can be easily outrun and allow you to go in for backstabs. If you misread a combo or missed a parry earlier in her attack chain, roll to iframe next attacks and wait for the next opportunity. Rolling into her with the Briar set on will easily stuns/interrupts her attacks. Magic and Ranged Users Critical Hits: This is a formidable boss which often requires lots of HP and FP, so it's recommended to have at minimum 25 Vigor, 20 Mind, and 10-12 flasks. For Sorcery users, it's best to use multi-hit spells with homing capabilities such as Glintblade Phalanx or Carian Phalanx . These fire-and-forget spells allow you to focus on dodging Alecto's swift and powerful attacks. You can use Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx on your weapon for quick access. Maintain your distance and wait for openings and breaks between her attacks to cast your spells and then prepare to dodge her upcoming onslaught. While these spells are not particularly damaging to Alecto, they deal massive damage to her Poise, allowing you to get a critical attack in. Keep up this strategy throughout the whole fight and you should be able to bring her down. Sweeping Attacks: When Alect

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader
sections.text: Black Knife Tiche Ashes Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Black Knife Tiche. Tiche was one of the assassins who, on the night of the plot, ' imbued her black knife with the Rune of Death and slew Godwyn ' the Golden. She was the daughter of the Black Knife Ringleader, ' Alecto, and was killed protecting her mother during their flight ' from the royal capital. Black Knife Armor Scale armor used by the Black Knife Assassins, forged to make no sound. Traces of power yet remain in its concealing veil, which muffles the sound of footsteps. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself. Black Knife Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives. A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death. Concealing Veil Talisman put together from dark cloth with a lustrous sheen. Completely conceals the wearer's presence while crouching at a distance from foes. Part of one of the concealing veils used by the assassins on the Night of Black Knives. Black Knifeprint On the Night of the Black Knives, someone stole a fragment of Death from Maliketh, the Black Blade, and imbued its power into the assassins' daggers. This mark is evidence of the ritual, and hides the truth of the conspiracy. Maliketh's Black Blade Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again. Assassin's Crimson Dagger An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in crimson. Critical hits restore HP. This charm is modelled after the darkly gleaming blades used in the Night of Black Knives. Those which gave the demigods their first taste of death. Assassin's Cerulean Dagger An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in cerulean. Critical hits restore FP. This charm is modelled after the darkly gleaming blades used in the Night of Black Knives. Those which gave the demigods their first taste of death. Cursemark of Death Cursemark carved into the discarded flesh of Ranni the Witch. Also known as the half-wheel wound of the centipede. This cursemark was carved at the moment of Death of the first demigod, and should have taken the shape of a circle. However, two demigods perished at the same time, breaking the cursemark into two half-wheels. Ranni was the first of the demigods whose flesh perished, while the Prince of Death perished in soul alone.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Ancestor Spirit Boss Guide
sections.text: Ancestor Spirit Boss Video Guide Ancestor Spirit Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Ancestor Spirit: Use spirit ashes that attack quickly, like Latenna The Albinauric or Demi-Human Spirit Ashes Use Rock Sling to get around its Magic resistance Bring a shield with 100% Physical defense, but only use it as a last resort if you can't avoid getting hit Wait to heal or buff until it uses Airborne Spirit Vapor Melee Strategy Legging It : Don't lock onto the Ancestor Spirit. Instead, aim for its legs and try to stay underneath it or towards its back legs. Attack its back legs to try to bait out Kick or its front legs to try to bait out Hoof Stomp, then punish those attacks. Stay patient, and avoid getting in unnecessary hits; there are plenty of changes to do damage safely. Magic and Ranged Strategy Keep a moderate distance from the boss and you should have plenty of opportunities to get off shots. Roll back whenever it starts a combo with Antler Swing, then back up while you shoot it. You'll have plenty of time for hits during Spirit Vapor attacks and in the recovery for moves like Prancing Drop. Ancestor Spirit Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Antler Swing Swings its antlers along the ground in one direction or another Roll through the swings Kick Briefly rears up on its hind legs, then puts its front legs down again and kicks behind it Start walking left or right when you see it rear up and this will miss you Antler Launch Plunges its antlers into the ground, then lifts them abruptly upwards Roll forward as it hunches down, then get in some hits as it recovers Hoof Slam Rises up on its hind legs and slams down its hooves, creating a shockwave Roll forward as it begins to descend, then get in a few hits during its long recovery Prancing Drop Leaps into the air and bounces twice in midair, hovers in the air for a second, then drops to the ground creating a shockwave After the second midair bounce, count to three then roll to either side to dodge the attack; or just run forward to end up behind the boss Airborne Spirit Vapor Jumps into the air and runs in a semicircle around you, breathing damaging vapor that lingers on the ground Keep your distance and avoid going in the vapor Grounded Spirit Vapor Walks forward and breathes damaging vapor that lingers on the ground counterclockwise in front of it This attack moves slowly, so just run away and avoid going in the vapor Ancestor Spirit Notes & Other Trivia Once the boss is defeated, you can leave by interacting with a white light in the middle of its arena. This light can be hard to spot due to the size of the arena, but won't miss it if you start with your back to the boss door and move forward

sections.heading: Elden Ring Ancient Dragon Lansseax Boss Guide
sections.text: Ancient Dragon Lansseax Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Ancient Dragon Lansseax: Use Latenna . Summon her far away from the boss and draw its attention away from her. She will deal steady damage to the boss but is quite frail and will not survive long if the boss is focused on her. Another good alternative is the Ancestral Follower . Use the Shard Spiral spell, as her large hitbox means that the attack can land multiple times. Bring some Lightningproof Dried Liver and Boiled Crab for damage negation. Turn off camera lock, as it can only lock onto the head and body of the dragon, which can be very disorienting. Melee Users When facing this boss, do not take the lightning attacks lightly since they have the ability to one-shot players. While in the air, you may see a resemblance of a weapon made with lightning. At this point you need to back up to prepare to jump over this weapon attack or dodge. Ideally stay on higher or lower ground so you can go over or under some its attacks. For greater speed, you may want to consider seeing this fight through while on Torrent so you can be quick in disengaging when needed. This way you can wait for openings and also quickly run in with Torrent for a quick hit and escape if needed. This will lessen the chances of getting stepped on than if you were to run in on foot. While on Torrent, it will also give you enough time to run away from any anticipated fire attacks or landing spaces. For attacks, Torrent will also be beneficial for reaching her head for attacks with his higher jumps, especially on higher ground. The main melee strategy is to keep moving and a combination of looking for openings to run in for a few hits and then running back out to repeat the process. Magic and Ranged Users With ranged attack, and a big field going against a dragon with large range, it is still recommended to use Torrent for this fight to quickly cover distances either for escaping an attack or running in for a better angle. Lots of the dragon's attack cover a large AoE. You will need to continuously disengage and move around to stay out of her line of sight and give yourself a better position to deal attacks. For range, it is a combination or circling back, stopping to get an angle and dealing an attack while anticipating her next attack and being prepared to back away. This may make it more difficult to aim with smaller ranged spells and attacks so you may still need to use Torrent to approach and get better angle to hit. If you keep moving, there is a chance she will constantly be trying to turn towards you and repositioning rather than dealing attacks, which will give you more opportunities to keep attacking while moving until she is eventually cleared. Ancient Dragon Lansseax Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Lansseax’s Glaive (slam) Lansseax stands onto her hind legs and raises her left arm. A massive bolt of red lightning appears in her grip. Lansseax then slams the lightning across the ground from her right to her left, releasing waves of lightning forwards across the ground. This attack will knock you to the ground if the initial lightning bolt connects. Note that both the slamming and sweeping glaive share the same windup animation; which attack is used is determined by how far the player is from Lansseax. The slam is used while relatively far away, while the sweep occurs if the player is too close. Dodge forwards through the attack and hit Lansseax's momentarily vulnerable head. Lansseax’s Glaive (sweep) Lansseax stands onto her hind legs and raises her left arm. A massive bolt of red lightning appears in her grip. Lansseax then sweeps the lightning across the ground from her right to her left, releasing waves of lightning forwards across the ground and jumping backwards as she does. This attack will knock you to the ground if the initial lightning bolt connects. Note that both the slamming and sweeping glaive share the same windup animation; which attack is used is determined by how far the player is from Lansseax. The slam is used while relatively far away, while the sweep occurs if the player is too close. Prevent this attack from occurring by moving backwards in order to trigger the slam instead. If she does use it, roll forwards through the sweep and pursue Lansseax. Aerial Glaive This attack is only used by the miniboss version in Crumbling Farum Azula. The dragon leaps backwards into the air and raises their left hand. A massive bolt of red lightning appears in their grip. The dragon then sweeps the bolt vertically downwards beneath and in front of themself before landing. Run diagonally forwards towards the dragon and attack their head when they land. Ancient Dragons’ Lightning Strike This attack is only used once by Lansseax, immediately after landing to begin the battle. The miniboss version in Crumbling Farum Azula will use it multiple times. sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Ancient Dragon Lansseax
sections.text: Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear A secret incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Creates a spear of red lightning and stabs it into the ground from above. On impact, the spear will burst into trails of lightning covering the area. Spoken of in legend, red lightning is the weapon wielded by the ancient dragons. Bolt of Gransax Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax. One of the legendary armaments. A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital - the only time in historical record that Leyndell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against dragons. Dragoncrest Shield Talisman Wrought iron talisman depicting a trio of ancient dragons. Boosts physical damage negation. The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock. And so it is that the shape of the dragon has become symbolic of all manner of protections. Dragon Towershield Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even among greatshields, it possesses exceptional guarding ability The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock. Fingerprint Helm Iron helm singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion? Gravel Stone A small clump of sharp, pointed stones. Material used for crafting items. Such compound stones, found in lands once beset by ancient dragons, are said to be the scales of those very beasts. Gravel Stone Seal Sacred seal made from Gravel Stone thought to be an ancient dragon scale. Enhances Dragon Cult incantations of the Royal Capital. The worship of the ancient dragons does not conflict with belief in the Erdtree. After all, this seal, and lightning itself, are both imbued with gold. Lansseax's Glaive Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon Lansseax. Creates a red-lightning glaive and sweeps the area from above. This attack unleashes trails of lightning. Lansseax was the sister of Fortissax. It is said that she took the form of a human to commune with the knights as a priestess of the ancient dragon cult. Lightning Spear One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons a lightning spear and hurls it before the caster. Charging causes a lightning bolt to strike the point of impact. Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe — an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital. Malformed Dragon Armor Malformed golden armor. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels. After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves. Old Lord's Talisman A legendary talisman depicting the ancient king whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond time. Extends the duration of sorceries and incantations. It is said that the ancient royal city of Farum Azula has been ' slowly crumbling since time immemorial. Remembrance of the Dragonlord Remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Dragonlord whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond ' time is said to have been Elden Lord in the age before the Erdtree. ' Once his god was fled, the lord continued to await its return. Vyke's Dragonbolt Incantation of Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. Summons red lightning to bolster both the caster's body and their armament held in the right hand. Enchants armaments with lightning-affinity attacks and increases maximum equipment load. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced. Of all the knights, Vyke the Dragonspear was the one Lansseax loved the most.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Ancient Dragon Senessax Boss Guide
sections.text: Ancient Dragon Senessax Boss Video Guide Ancient Dragon Senessax Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Ancient Dragon Senessax: Recommended Summons: Black Knife Tiche , Mimic Tear Ashes Recommended Spells: Rotten Breath , Ekzykes's Decay Avoid fighting in the pool of water, as it will further increase the range from Senessax's attacks. Melee Users As an ancient dragon, Senessax boasts high damage absorption. The battle begins with the dragon waking from its sleep and immediately performing Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike . Senessax will then take to the skies to launch a Fire Breath . You must evade this by rolling, as a direct hit can deplete 90% of your health or kill you instantly. This attack has a wide AoE so you will need to spam roll multiple times to either direction (left or right). One of the most accessible parts of the dragon to target is its feet. Since the dragon will be on the ground most of the time, you’ll have opportunities to strike its legs during combat. On the ground, Senessax relies on Lightning Slams and Sweeps . These attacks are powerful but avoidable. When you see the dragon raising its arms, immediately switch to defense and roll back as far as you can. Its lightning melee attacks have a wide damage area, making it crucial to maintain distance. Due to the size of its attack, you will roll twice for the lightning stomps and the swings can be avoided by rolling backwards. After the dragon launches an attack and misses, observe its movements closely. If it doesn't seem to attack again soon, take the opportunity to strike its legs and deal heavy damage. Be aware that when the dragon feels pressured by your attacks, it will often use its wings to blow you away, creating distance between you. One strategy that you can use against Ancient Dragon Senessax is to ride Torrent to go in and out of the battle. You can utilize Torrent to easily get out of the boss's reach whenever it attacks, then punish it when it is your turn to attack. You can also avoid Senessax's fire breath when riding Torrent as you are fast enough to outrun the flames. When attacking Senessax while riding Torrent, you should always go for its legs so you will be out of harm's way when you're attacking. One of the moves that the Ancient Dragon Senessax does is Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear where you see it raise its arms to conjure a lightning bolt, then, it will stab the ground with it to create a lightning AoE damage. This move will have a variation when the boss' health drops to 50%; it will make the same move for the second time after a slight delay. To dodge this move, start by jumping twice while riding Torrent, or you can also do a jump with your character. Another attack that is worth mentioning is Wingbeat , which is a common move that the boss makes where it flaps both wings to create a wind that will blow you away. This move creates a distance between the two of you and can stagger you when it connects. To avoid this attack, spam roll backwards until you get out of the AoE. To win the fight against Ancient Dragon Senessax, you need to time your attacks and be patient. Rushing in can lead to immediate death since almost all its attacks are very powerful. Regularly switch between defense and offense, evading more than attacking. Patience is critical; wait for the right moments to attack, and gradually, you’ll lower its health. Magic and Ranged Users Cheese strategy: Attack Senessax with rotten breath, or Ekzykes's decay until it becomes afflicted. Leave the boss arena. Repeat a total of three times. Sorcerers can cast rotten breath with bonus stats from equipment like Silver Tear Mask , Outer God Heirloom , Two Fingers Heirloom , and Marika's Soreseal . Ancient Dragon Senessax Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Shares most of its attacks with Ancient Dragon Lansseax , minus her Lightning Glaive attacks. See her page for more information. Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear Senessax conjures a red lightning bolt in its hand and stabs the ground below, creating a wave of red lightning, followed by an aftershock. At 50% health, they will summon two lightning spears. While riding Torrent, either run away or jump in between the attacks to avoid the grounded lightning waves. Divebomb The dragon flies backwards and hovers in the air for a moment before leaning back and rushing forward, crashing into the ground. Watch the dragon as it flies. If you see it lean back, it means the attack is about to happen. Dodge roll forward to avoid it. Ancient Dragon Senessax Notes & Other Trivia The description of both the regular and Hefty Red Lightning Pots suggest that this ancient dragon betrayed their lord and sided with Bayle, hence why they guard the path to the Summit. sections.heading: Elden Ring Ancient Dragon-Man Boss Guide
sections.text: Ancient Dragon-Man Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Shadow of the Erdtree Bosses Ranked Ancient Dragon-Man Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Ancient Dragon-Man: Use the ?? Ash Summons Use the ?? Spell Bring ?? Item Melee Users The Ancient Dragon-Man is encountered when you explore the Dragon's Pit . You will find the entrance after dropping down a deep pit in between a set of long stairs and a large basin in a candle-lit room. The Ancient Dragon-Man uses dodge rolls whenever you try to attack it, so it's better to punish this boss instead when you dodge its attacks or when it heals. He has 2 similar attacks, one of which he can perform a charging attack . He will distance himself from you and jump up, while he is in the air, he will charge up his attack and swing toward you, releasing a wave of damage that will lessen close to a third of your health. While he is charging his attack, this gives you time to dodge out of the way of the slash wave. He will also come closer to you and perform the same attack without charging up, so he may jump and slash down directly when he lands. You can try to strike him while he's in mid-air to knock him down. One of the moves that he can do is the Dragonwound Slash where you see him dash back to gain a distance from you and then will hop up and charge his blade to glow red. He will then slash it toward you sending a wave dealing heavy damage to you. This move can be dodged by rolling to the sides of the incoming slash wave as it goes toward your direction. He can also do the Dragonhead move, where you see a dragon strike forward to bite an area in front of him. You can either dodge this attack by rolling to either side or roll forward to retaliate. You can also dodge his attack to avoid receiving damage. You can corner him towards the wall and perform heavy attacks on him to break his Poise. He may move quickly but once you have him against a wall and his stance is broken, he is easy to defeat. The final tip for this boss is that it can heal when you reduce his health to about 50%, during this time, you can be aggressive and interrupt him during the animation. Magic and Ranged Users Strategy Writeup for Magic Users Ancient Dragon-Man Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Dragonwound Slash Leaps into the air, coating his blade with a red substance before slashing downwards. He may perform a charged variant of this attack, sending out a wave of energy directly forward. One of his more dangerous attacks due to the damage it can deal. Dodge to the sides or attack him during the animation to make him fall. Jump Slash Jumps upwards and slams the katana downwards. When he jumps while he is closer to you, you will have to dodge toward the sides or backward from his attack to avoid receiving damage quickly. Running Attack While running, the Dragon-Man pulls his katana back and thrusts forward. Another variant of this attack involves a slash, which comes out much quicker. Keep running and then roll to either side. Melee Combo Performs a slash, a thrust, then two more slashes. The last attack is slightly delayed. Interrupt him with a jumping heavy attack or try and parry him. Dragonmaw Hovers into the air and summons a massive dragon head, before violently biting down on anything in front of it. Easily his most dangerous attack, as it deals enough damage to one-shot players and is very difficult to interrupt. Instead, run away as soon as you see this spell. Magma Breath While grounded, he summons the head of a Magma Wyrm, which spits out a glob of magma which lingers on the ground. He may repeat this attack twice in succession. Another dangerous attack that can be easily dodged by rolling to the sides or running. Be aware of the lingering magma pool. Ancient Dragon-Man Notes & Other Trivia Every negation is -5, meaning it takes 5% extra damage from all eight damage types. Lightning is the clear pick at 166 defense; Fire is the worst answer at 211, with Holy close behind at 206. Poise is 0 and it can be both parried and backstabbed — it fights like a humanoid, not a dragon. It carries a single Flask of Crimson Tears charge, so expect exactly one heal and push through it. Every status resistance is a flat 525 with no immunities, so bleed, frost, rot and even sleep are all live options. Reaching it means dropping into the deep pit in the candle-lit room past the Dragon's Pit Site of Grace . At 21,859 HP it has far more health than its arena suggests, so bring a fight's worth of flasks.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Ancient Hero of Zamor Boss Guide
sections.text: Ancient Hero of Zamor Boss Video Guide Ancient Hero of Zamor Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Ancient Hero of Zamor: Glintblade Phalanx and Glintstone Arc can work wonders as they often avoid projectiles. Avoid relying on your shield, since it won't be very effective in Phase 2 Melee Users Free Damage: At the beginning of the fight, run in and get in a few hits. They'll often just dodge away once they're fully spawned, although they may also do a Spinning Swing. It's up to you whether the risk is worth the extra damage. You can get in free hits again while it's using Imbue Frost during the change from Phase 1 to Phase 2, which lasts 9 full seconds and doesn't do any damage. Bait & Strike: Stay outside its swing radius to bait out distance-closing attacks like Leaping Slam and the double clockwise swing combo. In Phase 2, Spring Forward and Triple Swing work as well. These moves tend to have fairly long recovery times, so you can get in a hit or two before backing off again and repeating the process. If you manage your distance well enough, you may also be able to run to the side and get in a hit when it uses Frost Breath as well. Parrying: Most of this boss's sword swings are parryable (consult the Attacks & Counters chart for exact details), and it tends to have relatively telegraphed wind-ups. If your timing is good, strap on a Buckler and this guy might be a breeze. Magic and Ranged Users Stand Back: The Ancient Hero's only fully ranged attack is Frost Breath, which is easy to dodge if you see it coming. This makes it relatively straightforward to stand back and attack from a distance. Just be wary of its distance-closing melee attacks, and keep enough stamina in reserve to dodge away once it tries to close in. It can even be useful to try to stay a bit closer to bait out a slower attack like Spinning Swing or Zamor Ice Storm, and then punish it from afar. Watch Your Elements: Faith users and archers should keep in mind this boss's weakness to Fire and Lightning damage. Flame Sling and Firebone Arrows are good early options that can take advantage of this weakness. Ancient Hero of Zamor Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Swing Swings its sword in a variety of directions Parry or dodge away and wait for the combo to end. Blocking isn't recommended, because you'll still take Magic damage and build Frostbite in Phase 2. This is usually parriable, but not if the Hero swings while retreating Spinning Swing Crouches down and spins its sword around a full turn and a half Roll away once, then come back and get in a few hits during the very long recovery Leaping Slam Jumps in the air and slams its sword down in front of it Roll forward when you see the sword become vertical, then get in a hit during the long recovery Frost Breath Kneels down and blows a stream icy wind in in front of cone that gradually grows larger as it travels. As soon as you see it kneel, run or jump to the side to avoid being in the area of effect. If you're close enough, you can move to its side or back and get in some free hits while it does this attack Frost Orb Puts its left hand over its right shoulder and quickly creates a sphere of magic around it, knocking enemies back and dealing minor damage. Roll away as soon as you see its arm move. Take care not to get hit by this too much, as it gives considerable Frost build-up. Imbue Frost Once it goes below 60% health, it falls to its knees, then enchants its sword with frost magic before rising and twirling around, beginning Phase 2 Run towards and wail on it as much as you can, as it becomes much more aggressive once it switches phases. Phase 2 Spring Forward Kneels briefly, then leaps forward into a counterclockwise swing Roll towards it once you see the sword start to fall, then get in a hit during recovery Leaping Swings Jumps into the air swinging its sword upwards, then swings it downwards as it falls Roll to either side Twiple Swing Jumps into the air and swings its sword downwards and clockwise, then swings twice clockwise in quick succession once it lands Roll away twice and then attack once it finishes its third swing Ice Burst Shoves its sword into the ground, then pulls it out creating a small burst of ice There's enough time to get a hit in before it pulls out the sword if you're careful. Otherwise, just keep your distance until the move is over. Zamor Ice Storm Builds up frost magic in its palm, then touches it to the ground to create a large whirlwind of ice that lasts a couple seconds Although this has a long windup, it's very difficult to stagger it out of the attack so it's best to just leave when you see it charging up. This is a great opportunity for getting in some ranged damage : Attack can be parried Ancient Hero of Zamor Notes & Other Trivia Fire and Lightning negation are both -20, so either element lands 20% harder than a physical weapon would. sections.heading: Elden Ring Astel, Naturalborn of the Void Boss Guide
sections.text: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void Boss Video Guide Astel, Naturalborn of the Void Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Astel, Naturalborn of the Void: It is advised you do not lock onto the boss unless you are performing an attack to give yourself more manoeuvrability. Use the Mimic Tear Ashes or any other tanky summon that can draw the boss's attention away. When playing a more tanky or physical build and not wanting to change, Latenna 's spirit ash is fairly cheap and will deal significant damage to Astel, as long as you keep its attention away. Ancestral Follower can also work well. The crystalline "body" has greater defense than the hand-like limbs or head, but can be attacked while staying out of range of most attacks barring shockwaves. Once it teleports, face your camera upwards to see if it's preparing to grab you. Melee Users At the start of the encounter it will likely fire a laser that can deal massive damage to you on the spot. Dodge through it and, if you want it, summon your Spirit Ashes . Dodge through its attacks up until you reach it and, by then, stay on its head while dodging every attack. It has a lot of AoE skills that might one or two-shot you so stay on the safe side and slowly chip away its HP. If you summoned your Spirit Ashes - they'll often distract him which gives you plenty of opportunities to get some attacks in. Don't get hit by its bite attack. It'll be indicated by the mandibles glowing purple on its face. It is easily dodged but can deal massive damage if it connects. Around 50%, Astel will teleport away and cast Meteorite of Astel on you. Dodge through them or run towards the sides, as even one of them can break through your guard and deal heavy damage. The fight itself doesn't change as its HP goes down, so if you're doing everything right, you'll have it downed in no time. Magic and Ranged Users Longbow users may use Poison or Rot Arrows to trigger either status effects. You must hit Astel several times in a row to proc the status ailment, missing too many shots will allow its poison or rot buildup to go down faster than you can build it. If you have enough HP to tank a few hits, the Pulley Crossbow can apply status effects very fast. The status effects can be reapplied again once they have worn off. The Ash of War: Enchanted Shot is highly recommended while using these arrows to ensure you are not missing and wasting them. While it is poisoned or rotting, you may continue to do ranged battle with regular arrows. You can also conserve FP by switching down to R1 attacks. With the Arrow's Reach Talisman , you can ensure these R1 attacks will land without damage loss due to distance, giving an acceptable chip damage if your Longbow is at least +12. For magic users, A high-intelligence build can do a lot of damage in a short period of time. Using Comet Azur with a Flask of Wondrous Physick ( Cerulean Hidden Tear + Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear ) after dodging the initial attacks is a good combination to try. After this attack, try staying at medium-long range where a sorcery like Great Glintstone Shard can hit him. If you use these types of spells, you can attack quick enough to dodge many of its attacks while still doing fairly decent damage. For lower intelligence casters, Night Maiden's Mist isn't a terrible option, although it is decently fast and can move out of it from time to time. sections.heading: Elden Ring Astel, Stars of Darkness Boss Guide
sections.text: Astel, Stars of Darkness Boss Video Guide Astel, Stars of Darkness Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Astel, Stars of Darkness: Ranged Ashes like Latenna and the Ancestral Follower will almost always aim for the head, dealing extra damage from afar. Tanky Ashes like Tiche , Rollo , and Crystalian can provide distraction. Rock Sling can easily stun the boss. Comet Azur can work if it is uninterrupted. Move the middle of the arena when it teleports away, to prevent being grabbed by the clones. Pest Threads can deal a large amount of damage against the boss with the proper targeting and angle. Giant Hunt can do massive damage when targeting the head and will cause a poise break every few hits. It’s easier to hit if Astel is distracted by a Spirit. Melee Users Stay out of the exploding clouds, and attack the head with Jump Attacks when there is an opening. Avoid attacking too frequently, as Astel can quickly chain together attacks. It is recommended to stay close to the head, as the bite attacks can be easily dodged. But one must be wary of the Gravity Wave attacks he does when one is under him for too long Magic and Ranged Users Don't underestimate the tail attack, as it has a very long range and it may one-shot you if you don't dodge. Astel has limited ranged options, opting to use a long ranged attack or its tail to hit you from afar. Keep an out for when it teleports, if you don't spot it anywhere, it may have teleported above you, getting ready for an extremely powerful grab attack. Astel, Stars of Darkness Attacks & Counters Most of its attacks are identical to the Remembrance version. See the Astel, Naturalborn of the Void page for more information. Attack Description Counter Grab Occurs at around 50% health, where it will perform the Diving Grab, but will instead summon many identical copies from the sides of the arena to catch the player. Aim the camera upwards to see if Astel has teleported above you. If it has summoned its copies, stand still in the middle of the arena to avoid it. Astel, Stars of Darkness Notes & Other Trivia The description of the Remembrance of the Naturalborn implies a connection between Astel and the Fallingstar Beasts .

sections.heading: Elden Ring Battlemage Hugues Boss Guide
sections.text: Battlemage Hugues Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Battlemage Hugues: For melee users, try using a heavy or colossal weapon as the mage is easily staggered. Try equipping the Rock Sling spell for magic users. Bring the Carian Knight's Shield to block his many magic attacks. Melee Users Once you start the battle, walk up towards the summoning area, and quickly go behind the mage to perform a backstab. You can easily circle around the mage and continue performing backstab. If you manage to screw the rotation it's fine, wait for the mage to perform the Gavel of Haima and dodge roll through the slam, you can quickly get behind him and do a backstab, or you can just get a few swings in if you prefer that. If you're using a colossal or heavy weapon, you'll easily stagger him with just a few swings, breaking his string of attacks. Once he's on his knees, you can then perform a crit attack. Magic and Ranged Users If you are a magic and ranged user, it's best to have a shield that can highly negate magic damage like the Carian Knight's Shield , he will use the Glintstone Shard spell if you try to create some distance, so you can either time your dodge correctly to avoid the attack or block it. You can try baiting him in using some melee attacks then dodge roll away, then cast your spells/incantations or fire away some arrows. Alternatively you can just use Night Maiden's Mist . Get the tree between you and the boss and shoot the mist over the tree. Hughes will automatically retaliate as long as he takes damage, effectively pining himself into the mist but you should be safe with the trunk acting as a shield. Reapply the mist before it ends to kill him effortlessly. Battlemage Hugues Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Gavel of Haima When his target is at close-ranged, Hugues summons a magic hammer from his staff and slams it down twice. Roll away or get behind him. Cannon of Haima When his target is very far away from him, he will begin charging up before firing a projectile that explodes upon hitting the ground or the target. Roll towards him or run to the sides. Club Swing Hugues swings his club up to 8 times, dealing rather mediocre damage Can be easily rolled through or blocked. Headbutt Hugues swings his head back and headbutts his target using his Glintstone Crown. Simply roll back or block it. Great Glintstone Shard Hugues casts projectiles up to 6 times, dealing Magic Damage. Run to the sides or quickly attack to interrupt him. Battlemage Hugues Notes & Other Trivia The same enemy can be encountered as a Battlemage around various locals, like Altus Plateau and Liurnia.

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Battlemage Hugues
sections.text: Battlemage Hugues Ashes Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Battlemage Hugues. Hugues came from Sellia to study the Haima Conspectus at the academy, where he became a battlemage. Haima scholars seek to quell conflict with cannon fire and the gavel, but Hugues developed a longing for it. Battlemage Robe Robe worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield. Whenever war broke out and the academy sealed its gates, only Haima's scholars dared venture outside. Seclusion is no way to foster discovery; it is only a convenient form of escape. Cannon of Haima One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Lobs an explosive magic projectile that flies in an arc. Charging enhances potency. Drawn from the conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict. Haima Glintstone Crown One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Increases intelligence and strength to the detriment of FP. Scholars of the Haima Conspectus sought the power to quell conflict, and to this end studied the sorceries of cannon fire and the gavel. Stone Club Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand. sections.heading: Elden Ring Bayle The Dread Boss Guide
sections.text: Bayle The Dread Boss Video Guide Recommended Build ER Shadow of the Erdtree Dragon Priestess Build Written Guide Bayle the Dread Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Bayle The Dread: Recommended summons: Redmane Knight Ogha Recommended armaments: Dragon King's Cragblade Recommended spells: Ekzykes's Decay , Loretta's Mastery , Frenzied Burst , Meteorite of Astel Recommended Talismans: Godfrey Icon , Blue Dancer Charm , Ritual Sword Talisman , Great-Jar's Arsenal Bring Dragonwound Grease or preferably Dragon Communion Grease to more effectively deal damage Any weapon with bonus against Dragons will prove useful Other items: Cerulean Hidden Tear in mixed Physick, to cast an expensive spell in order to end his first phase quicker. Other options include Opaline Bubbletear / Hardtear or Crimson Crystal Tear for survivability. Melee Users Bayle the Dread can be found in the crater of Jagged Peak. From the Jagged Peak Summit Site of Grace Map Link , head straight through the stone archway, and Bayle will appear shortly after. This boss deals both Fire and Lightning damage, and when it breathes fire, the attack is a mixture of both elements. Bayle also leaps and flies around the arena, creating significant distance between you. NOTE : If you are progressing Igon's questline, be sure to use his summon sign inside Bayle's arena. Summoning Igon for this fight is crucial to completing his quest. To tackle this fight against Bayle, you can opt to lock in on his head but your camera will follow all of its movements and make it difficult to track him. For now, there are no other lock-in options aside from its head. On the other hand, you can also focus on hitting the leg, without locking in your camera, to continuously inflict damage, but this will also prevent you from seeing what the incoming attacks are due to its massive size. This fight is a lot more difficult for melee users, but this is why you will use the Dragon Communion Grease or Dragonwound Grease to deal more damage by coating your armament. Due to the fast movements of Bayle the Dread, it is recommended to take on this boss with Light equip load and pair it with the Blue Dancer Charm , Great-Jar's Arsenal , and Godfrey Icon . This gives you more iFrames and makes dodging easier on foot for melee users. You can also add in Erdtree's Favor +2 to further raise your maximum HP, Stamina, and Equip Load. This will let you dodge more frequently as you chip away at the boss' health. You can stay under its leg and hit him from there, as the tail doesn't have any hitbox as of the current patch (1.12.3). Unlike other dragons, Bayle props itself up with its wings due to losing most of its left leg. This gives the dragon a hunched posture, making it harder to get underneath as you would with other large dragons. However, its head is more accessible for melee attacks, and both the head and left leg take additional damage. The wings can sometimes make it difficult to reach the leg, requiring an approach from the front or from the side. As with most dragons, using a piercing weapon like a spear, thrusting sword, pickaxe, or the Rusted Anchor is recommended. Bayle has several attacks aside from its Fire and Lightning breath — Fatal Bites , Fatal Crush , Tail Swipe and a Lunging Claw Stab . During Maul , Bayle lunges forward to bite you repeatedly, potentially leading to instant death. To avoid this, be ready to dodge roll forward or to the side. Fatal Stomp involves Bayle hovering briefly, then gliding toward you and landing with brute force. When you see Bayle in the air, run away or dodge to avoid the impact. For the Tail Swipe , Bayle turns and swings its tail at you. When Bayle starts to turn, dodge roll forward to evade the attack. Finally, the Lunging Claw Stab occurs when Bayle hunches back slightly, and then lunges forward to stab with its claw. This attack happens almost instantly, so be prepared to roll to the side or forward, allowing you to close in for an attack. Bayle also has several powerful Fire and Lightning breath attacks . One is an arena-wide attack, where Bayle sweeps Fire and Lightning from one side to the other. Another is an AoE attack, where it breathes Fire and Lightning downward, covering a wide area. You can dodge roll to avoid both of these attacks. The last attack is the Straight breathing attack , where it breathes Fire and Lightning directly at you. You can easily dodge roll to the side since it doesn't track your movement. After defeating Bayle the Dread , you will receive 490,000 Runes and the Heart of Bayle . Magic and Ranged Users Casters should avoid using lock-on except for spell projectiles that rely on a target lock. Bayle will frequently close the gap and position his body over you, which can make the camera erratic, making dodging difficult. Additionally, aiming for Bayle's head can cause spells to miss despite his torso or tail being in range. Sorcery users can utilize Ranni's Dark Moon to weaken Bayle with frostbite. During Bayle's p

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Bayle the Dread
sections.text: Dragonwound Grease Solidified grease made from a gravel-stone mixture. Craftable item. Coats armament, granting an anti-dragon effect. ' The effect lasts only for a short time. When the dragons were born from their ancient kin, they lost their stone scales, which can now be used to cause them mortal harm. Talisman of the Dread Talisman depicting the dread dragon of the jagged peak, whose roars cause the peak's molten fury to boil and churn. Raises potency of magma. Bayle was the foul dragon's name — a terrible harbinger of destruction whose challenge to the ancient Dragonlord ended in grievous mutual injury. Heart of Bayle The biatrial heart of Bayle the Dread. Dotted with horn-like gravel stones and glistening with deep-red liquor. Gorge upon this at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion to absorb Bayle's power. The purest form of Communion, in the words of its priestess. Bayle's Flame Lightning One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread. Channels the form of the dread dragon in right arm to smash foes with an exposed talon bone coursing with flame lightning. Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day. Bayle's Tyranny One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations. Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread. Channels the form of the dread dragon to emit a mighty roar accompanied by a heatwave burst, causing violent eruptions of fire in the area. Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day. Hefty Red Lightning Pot Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. ' A cocktail of red fulminating materials is sealed inside. Throw at an enemy to inflict heavy lightning damage that links to surrounding enemies. The ancient dragons who betrayed their lord to side with a tyrant were known for wielding branching red lightning. Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect. Formerly a Dragon Communion warrior, the Ancient Dragon-Man was once arbiter of those worthy to devour the Dreaded One. Igon's Cookbook (1) A record of crafting techniques left by a warrior who challenged the vile dragon Bayle, only to be grievously injured and broken by fear. Contains details on how a mere mortal can fell a mighty dragon. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Dragon Communion Grease - Dragon Communion Harpoon Dragon's Calorbloom Flower with an uncanny shape, coursing with hot blood. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. A single flower is said to blossom—only once—from the hearts of dead warriors who oft partook of the Dragon Communion.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Beast Clergyman Boss Guide
sections.text: Beast Clergyman Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Beast Clergyman Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Beast Clergyman: Use the Mimic Ash Summons. If you have Tiche, she destroys his health. The second phase is immune to the Death Blade attack. Bring the Blasphemous Claw item for his second phase. Melee Users Strategy Writeup for Melee Users (Work in progress) A safe way to get through the first phase is to hug one of the pillars. This will block most of the Beast Clergyman's attacks. He has one attack that is relatively safe to punish: You want to wait until he sticks his knife into the ground and then drags it across the screen from left to right. You can punish this with a jumping attack and then quickly return to circling the pillar. It can take a while to deal damage to him this way, but is a safe way to get through phase one. This attack is easier to see coming if you circle anti-clockwise. Sometimes the lock-on will break, so try and reapply it when safe. Be careful not to stand too close to the pillar, as some of his attacks may still cause damage through it. Magic and Ranged Users The Beast Clergyman uses many fast and rapid attacks at close range, maintain your distance and use spells that don't have long charge ups for this fight. Move around the pillars to use them as cover against the ranged rock throwing attacks when using flasks but try to watch out for the Beast Claw attack during this time as this attack will ignore the pillar. Beast Clergyman Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Rock Spray The boss drags its left hand on the ground, picking up rocks which it holds before throwing at you Roll to the side or move behind a pillar Rock Throw The boss drags its left hand on the ground and holds up a boulder before throwing it at you Move or Roll to the side, or move behind a pillar Beast Claw The boss Raises their left arm in the air creating visible shock wave lines then slams their hand into the ground before swinging their arm at the player shortly after, sending shock waves towards the player. The shock waves are not stopped by the pillars in the room. Roll to the side Swipe attacks Multiple quick furious swipes with the sword in their right hand. 2 quick swipes, a forehand then a backhand, that can be followed up with more attacks Roll backwards and away from the boss to get out of range Fist smash The boss holds its weapon in its mouth and slams the ground with its fists, causing random spots to crack, showing where boulders will shoot up and then hit the ground Run away at the start of the attack. Look at the ground to not run into the boulders Beast Clergyman Notes & Other Trivia Voice Actor: Jonathan Keeble This boss is somewhat similar to the Guardian Ape from Sekiro, in the sense that he wildly swings multiple times at the player with large claws (as beasts do). His use of incantations and special abilities make him far different in terms of strategy, however. Dialogue Introduction: (If not all Deathroot has been given to Gurranq ): Thou, who approacheth Destined Death. I will not have it stolen from me again. (If all 9 Deathroot has been given to Gurranq): Tarnished. Why wouldst thou... Why... Tis no matter. I hereby vow, that Destined Death shall not be stolen again During Fight: (During transformation cutscene): O, Death. Become my blade, once more. After Fight: (If not all Deathroot has been given to Gurranq): Witless Tarnished... Why covet Destined Death? To kill what? (If all 9 Deathroot has been given to Gurranq): Forgive me, Marika... The Golden Order... cannot be restored.

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Beast Clergyman
sections.text: Stone of Gurranq Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. Hurls a boulder before the caster. This incantation can be cast repeatedly. Long ago, Gurranq was a beast of such terrifying ferocity that his former name meant "Death of the Demigods." Deathroot A source that gives rise to Those Who Live in Death. The beast clergyman, found at Bestial Sanctum in the distant east, collects and devours these roots. On the night of the dire plot the stolen Rune of Death enabled the first Death of a demigod. Later, the Rune of Death spread across the Lands Between through the underground roots of the Greattree, sprouting in the form of Deathroot. Remembrance of the Black Blade Remembrance of Maliketh, the Black Blade, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Maliketh was a shadowbound beast given to his Empyrean. Marika's sole need of her shadow was a vessel to lock away Destined Death. Even then, she betrayed him.

sections.text: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman More... I am not Sated. Bring me more Death. sections.heading: Beastman of Farum Azula Boss Guide for Elden Ring
sections.text: Beastman of Farum Azula Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Beastman of Farum Azula: Bait its long attack combos and counterattack once it's finished. Try to avoid blocking since its attacks drain so much stamina. Use Rotten Stray Ashes to take advantage of its relatively low resistance to Scarlet Rot . Melee Strategy Bait and Punish: Bait the Beastman's attacks until it completes a full combo before attacking a couple of times and then backing away. Its weapon drains a lot of stamina if you block it, so after you land a few hits it's better to dodge back far enough that you're out of range of its swings. When in doubt, stay as far away as you can. This boss doesn't have a ton of stance, so charged or jumping heavy attacks will stance-break it easily. Parrying: Most of the Beastman's attacks can be parried, except for the Two-Hand Slam and the last two attacks of the 6-Hit Combo (the uppercut and the overhead attack). Magic and Ranged Strategy Keep Your Distance: This fight is considerably easier at range. You can bait out its combos the same way you would in melee, but you can punish them from range rather than running into danger. Just keep your distance when it begins attacking and only block if you absolutely have to. Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter One-Handed Double Swing Cleaver: Grabs its cleaver with one hand and swings it twice horizontally. Parry the first swing or roll away. Avoid blocking, since it will lose you a lot of stamina. Two-Handed Double Swing Cleaver: Grabs its cleaver with two hands and swings it twice horizontally. Much faster than the One-Handed Double Swing, but covers much less range. Parry the first swing or roll away. Avoid blocking, since it will lose you a lot of stamina. Cleaver Stab ' ' Cleaver: Pulls its cleaver back and then stabs it forward Roll to your right to avoid the follow-up Overhead Slam Cleaver: Pulls its cleaver over its head and slams it down in front Roll to your right to avoid the follow-up Sideswipe Cleaver: Steps to its left and swings its cleaver clockwise along with it Roll right and get in a hit while it recovers Spinning Slice Cleaver: Spins in a full clockwise circle ending with a horizontal slice Roll right, since the hitbox is mostly towards the end of the attack Barbaric Roar Cleaver: Lets loose a fearsome roar dealing damage in a small area of effect Roll backwards and prepare to dodge the follow-up combo 6-Hit Combo Cleaver: Roars, then attacks six times: four horizontal swings, an upwards vertical attack which launches it into the air, then a final overhead slam. Dodge away and keep your distance during most of the combo, then roll in during the final slam and attack during its recovery animation. Two-Hand Slam Cleaver: Grabs its cleaver with two hands, jumps forward, and slams it into the ground. There's a long delay before it jumps, so be careful not to roll too soon. Once you successfully dodge, you have time to get in a few attacks of your own. : Attack can be parried Beastman of Farum Azula (Cleaver) Combo Chart

sections.heading: Bell Bearing Hunter Combat information
Notes and Other Trivia
sections.text: The Bell Bearings earned from defeating the Bell Bearing Hunter are kept when going into New Game Plus . For those looking to follow in his footsteps, actual merchant bell bearings are not kept. The Bell Bearing Hunter will show up if one fast travels to the site of grace while it is nighttime. As mentioned above, one will have to rest once more if they decided to rest at the site of grace until nightfall in order for the field boss to spawn. The iteration of the Bell Bearing Hunter that shows up in Dragonbarrow is notably stronger than all other versions despite being encounterable much earlier in the game. Because of this, this fight is ill-advised for early-to-mid game players. Defeating Elemer of the Briar has no impact on encounters with the Bell Bearing Hunter, but is necessary in order to acquire his shield , the Briar Set , and the Marais Executioner's Sword .
