sections.heading: Margit, the Fell Omen Boss Guide for Elden Ring
sections.text: Video Guide for Margit, the Fell Omen Boss Margit, the Fell Omen Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Margit, the Fell Omen: Purchase Margit's Shackle from Patches to bind him to the ground, temporarily stunning him. This allows you to get a few free hits. This will not work once he reaches Phase 2. Using the Lone Wolf Ashes can help distract Margit long enough to get some easy damage in with spells or melee attacks. The Spirit Jellyfish can act as a great tanky distraction, and is available if you speak to Roderika in Stormhill . Another good multi-summon Ashes are the Godrick Soldiers , found in the graveyard surrounded by Spirit Jellyfish in Stormhill. Glintstone Stars works well in this fight if you can get enough distance to use them. Glintstone Pebble can work fine as well, as it is cheap and reliable. Wait for him to do his leaping plunge attack with his hammer, and roll through it towards him to get in some easy damage. This is your best opening during this fight. Ash of War: Barricade Shield can make this fight much easier for melee players, because it allows them to block and attack more easily, though his summoned weapons do not deal Physical Damage , so you still take chip damage. Great boss to learn how to parry. Do note that it takes two parries to put him in a state where he can be riposted. The majority of his staff attacks are parryable, but his magic weapon attacks are not. This simplifies the fight a lot, as most of his attack sequences open with the staff. Melee Strategy Margit is a tough fight for melee users due to his aggressive nature and long combos with extended wind-ups, making it difficult to block all of his attacks. You will need to dodge roll most of his moves, blocking only when necessary to conserve stamina for counterattacks. Using the Lone Wolf Ashes can help you attack alongside the wolves, allowing you to break his stance and staggering him for a critical hit. Keep up the pressure to trigger this more often. Having high HP can help you trade hits more effectively. Margit deals both Physical and Holy damage (indicated by his yellow glowing weapon effects), so wear armor and talismans that protect against both. Avoid armor that results in a heavy roll. Bait his attacks and only strike when you are sure that he has stopped attacking, as he can extend certain combos if you overextend. You will likely trade damage occasionally, but that's okay. Watch out for his leaping hammer attack — dodge roll towards him and land a hit or two during his landing animation. Avoid getting greedy; you can usually only attack once without taking damage, and doing so too often will result in you running out of consumables. Consider slotting Ash of War: Bloody Slash for its quick, long-range burst damage, though it does cost some health. You should already have this Ash of War if you have completed Kenneth Haight's questline. Magic and Ranged Strategy The strategy for Magic and Ranged users is somewhat easier, though Shortbow users may have a harder time due to lower damage and lack of a Shield . Margit can either be extremely aggressive or not, and there seems to be no in-between. If you can keep separation from him until he goes into a "not aggressive" phase, then you can attack him at range fairly easily for a short time, getting some free damage. Just make sure to watch out for his Blade Toss attack, so you don't get hit. You could try using Glintstone Pebble or Glintstone Stars , as these are incredibly effective and efficient. Their cast times are in the mid-range, so be warned that you'll have to have proper spacing to use them. Additionally, it's not a bad idea to use a Shield in your off-hand to block in case of emergencies or after you cast, in case you cut it too close. You can use the Lone Wolf Ashes to create a distraction that can allow you to range him down in less than a minute, if you play it right. Wait for the wolves to gain his attention, then unleash spell after spell, making sure to pause when you gain aggro. This gives the wolves time to acquire it once again before continuing your barrage. Elden Ring Margit Notes & Other Trivia Voice Actor: Anthony Howell The reason for Margit's appearance in Stormveil is likely due to the fact that Godrick is considered the weakest demigod and would be the first target of those seeking the Great Runes. Margit will later appear in the Capital Outskirts of Leyndell, posing as a regular Commoner . He will use the exact same moveset, along with the Phase 2 transition. He drops the Viridan Amber Medallion +1 upon defeat. Defeating Margit’s true form will also prevent him from appearing at Stormveil Castle . He will also drop the Talisman Pouch . Oddly enough, defeating his true form will not stop the Capital Outskirts encounter from occurring. The spectral dagger he summons for his dagger throw and slash attacks is an Erdsteel Dagger , and for his hammer attacks, he uses a Giant-Crusher . sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Margit, the Fell Omen
sections.text: Fell Omen Cloak A cloak of ragged fur worn about the exposed body of Margit, the Fell Omen. Having slaughtered countless champions during the Shattering, the Fell Omen has become a horror to those who harbor ambitions for the Erdtree, or for Lordship. Morgott's Great Rune A Great Rune of the shardbearer Morgott. Its blessing greatly raises maximum HP. This Great Rune is the anchor ring that houses the base, and proves two things: That the Omen King was born of the golden lineage, and that he was indeed the Lord of Leyndell. Remembrance of the Omen King Remembrance of Morgott, the Omen King, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Though born one of the graceless Omen, Morgott took it upon himself to become the Erdtree's protector. He loved not in return, for he was never loved, but nevertheless, love it he did. Regal Omen Bairn Doll of a curseborn bairn from the Erdtree's royal line. Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase down foes. Omen babies born of royalty do not have their horns excised, but instead are kept underground, unbeknownst to anyone, imprisoned for all eternity. These memorial fetishes are fashioned in secret. Margit's Shackle A fetish bathed in golden magic. Shackles were used to bind the accursed people called the Omen, and these ones were made to keep a particular Omen under strictest confinement. Though faint, the shackles still retain vestiges of power — enough to trap the once-bound Margit on earth, if only for a short time. Night's Cavalry Armor Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads at night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Messmer the Impaler Boss Guide
sections.text: Messmer the Impaler Boss Video Guide Shadow of the Erdtree Bosses Ranked Messmer the Impaler Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Messmer the Impaler: Recommended summons: Mimic Tear Recommended armaments: Staff of the Guilty , Bloodfiend's Arm , Great Stars , Reduvia , Rivers of Blood , Heater Shield , Fingerprint Stone Shield (Fire affinity) Recommended ashes of war: Lion's Claw , Giant Hunt , Cragblade , Golden Vow Any skill, that lowers the player's position is good to both attack and avoid damage (Messmer mostly go for spear in forward, not down). Recommended spells: Flame Protect Me , Impenetrable Thorns , Golden Vow , Swarm of Flies , Borealis's Mist Recommended talismans: Flamedrake Talisman +3 , Great-Jar's Arsenal , Lord of Blood's Exultation Other items: Albinauric Set , Briar Set , Greenspill Crystal Tear , Stonebarb Cracked Tear Melee Users Phase 1 Messmer, the Impaler, looks down over you as a towering humanoid boss with long limbs and a massive spear, accompanied by a red snake coiled around his body. His attacks are imbued with fire damage, making him a formidable opponent who relies heavily on his spear's reach and agility. To proceed in this boss fight, readiness for his swift movements is important. As a melee character, your strategy should begin by evading the fireball he summons upon leaping into battle. Pay attention while he's in mid-air and watch out for the white smoke that will appear around him. As soon as you see the white smoke, get ready to dodge to avoid the impact of his landing. Sometimes, the area around him will explode as soon as he lands, so you need to do a second roll going forward, and then get a free hit while he's recovering. For the most part, you will want to stay close to him because of the long reach of his spear and flame spells. When you're fighting Messmer at a close range, you will have more chance of retaliating and chipping away at his health while he recovers. Engaging Messmer patiently is the best strategy to effectively take him down. When he finishes a string of attacks, focus on breaking his poise by pulling off heavy attacks for a chance to deal significant damage. Due to Messmer's speed, you need to approach him with the right mix of patience and aggressiveness. This boss can quickly transition between offense and defense by quickly disengaging with a leap after he finishes a move. Be aware that Messmer counters swiftly after sustaining damage, too. His speed and precision in combat are his biggest asset, requiring observation of his movements to avoid being overwhelmed. One of the basic moves that Messmer makes is the Flaming Spear Lunge , this is when you see him leap into the air as he thrusts his weapon and then crash on the ground with his spear engulfed in flames. This movement is dodgeable and will take some time to get used to but you can do this by rolling forward as he thrusts his weapon, waiting for the delay as he prepares to crash, and then rolling forward again to stay close to him. This allows you to attack him while he's recovering. Next up is Messmer's Flaming Assault , which is a 3-string attack where he combines this move with his flame spells. While the spear is engulfed in flames, he will cast spells with his flaming right hand and he will do the following attacks: When he swings his right arm, he will use a fire spell that affects the immediate area in front of him Quick Thrust with the spear, followed by a quick jump to reposition himself and another spear thrust Flame Spell where he twists in place to swing his spear and creates a flame surrounding him To dodge this move, you need to learn when he will do this by paying attention to his arm. If you see him cross it over and it's engulfed in flames, he will do this attack. To dodge, roll to the right if you're too close, otherwise, rolling backward is safe enough. You need to dodge as soon as he swings his arm engulfed in flames. For the second part, roll forward as soon as he thrusts with his spear, wait for the delay as he jumps to reposition himself, then dodge as soon as he lands on his new spot. Finally, for the last step, you can dodge this either going to the right, backward, or forward. It is recommended to roll forward so you can get close to him and get a free attack while he's recovering. Messmer's powerful Grab attack will kill most players instantly. It is important to dodge this attack to avoid an instant death. When Messmer's hand begins glowing, that is the sign he is about to grab you. Once he begins to descend his arm to grab you, roll either to the sides or forward. This will leave an opening to hit him. If you can break his stance, remember to go in front of him and just lightly press R1 (once) to do a light attack. This will do a critical hit and can deal a lot more damage than any attacks. sections.heading: Messmer The Impaler in Elden Ring DLC
sections.text: In one of the main pieces of artwork of Messmer the Impaler he is shown to be sitting on one of the thrones in Morgott the Omen King ’s arena, in the words of game director Hidetaka Miyazaki this symbolizes he is at least on equal terms to other demigods and children of Queen Marika . Part of the DLC will be exploring why the Lands of Shadow exists, as well as their relationship with this mysterious antagonist. Messmer, the Impaler did also feature prominently in the new Story Trailer released on May 21st. In said trailer, he is seen alongside his army, razing a city and setting it aflame, burning it to the ground.

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Messmer the Impaler
sections.text: Remembrance of the Impaler Remembrance of Messmer the Impaler, hewn into the Scadutree. ' The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. ' Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A malevolent snake writhed within Messmer, and so his very mother plucked out his eye and put in its place a seal of grace. Yet, having done so, her fear compelled her to secret away her child within the realm of shadow. Hidden away—keeping company with the original sin, and a hatred that would not be confined. Messmer's Helm Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents. Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's flame as well as Fire Knight skills. ' The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions. They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form, born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he. Messmer's Orb An incantation of Messmer the Impaler. Summons Messmer's flame to form a giant floating orb. The orb soars toward a foe, crashes into the earth, and explodes after a brief delay. Charging enhances potency. Messmer despised his own fire. Time and time again he hoped to rid himself of it, but ever did it burn. Messmer's Kindling The kindling that burned inside Messmer the Impaler. ' A dark thing, eaten away at by a wicked serpent. Burns the sealing tree said to be found at the old Rauh ruins. Messmer, much like his younger sister, bore a vision of fire. Fire Knight Armor Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Distinguished by its red cape and twin golden snakes which adorn the neck, enhancing incantations of Messmer's flame. These were the only ones who truly knew Messmer. His flames, like serpents. The painful fate that accompanied his accursed form. Winged Serpent Helm Helm of Kood, captain of the Fire Knights. A winged serpent perches atop it. Enhances Fire Knight skills. The winged serpent is the token creature of Messmer's military forces. It is a wise friend which keeps the base serpent at bay and holds its power in check. Blessing of Marika A special physick blessed by Marika, the queen of the Erdtree. Completely restores HP and heals all ailments. Marika once created several of these physicks for Messmer's sake. ' But never again. Serpent Crest Shield A finely-made "redshield" featuring an engraving of a winged serpent. Excels at guarding against fire. Said to have been made to commemorate the beginnings of the crusade started by Messmer, son of Marika. Messmer's Armor Black armor of Messmer the Impaler. ' Draped with a red cloak bearing his crest embroidered. On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired. "Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone." Black Pyrefly Fiery butterfly with black cinder wings. Material used for crafting items. Flies in war-torn lands that have been scoured by Messmer's flame. They burn in dark and slender ribbons of fire. Spear of the Impaler Weapon of Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. Remade by the forging arts of the realm of shadow, this weapon can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact. Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider Remembrance of Commander Gaius, hewn into the Scadutree. ' The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Both were as elder brothers to the lion, and both were cursed from birth. In spite of, or perhaps because of this very reason, ' Gaius was both Messmer's friend and the leader of his men. Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight Remembrance of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, hewn into the Scadutree. ' The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Once a Carian princess, Rellana disavowed her birthright and chose to stand at Messmer's side instead, knowing full well that not even the brilliance of the moon could grant him succor. Before long, she became known as the Sword of Messmer. Black Knight Commander Andreas Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. ' Use to summon the spirit of Andreas, Knight-Commander of the Black Knights. The Black Knights were the primary force of Messmer's army. Their first leader was Andreas, a man endowed with great strength and command over the powers of the Crucible, and whose spirit in these ashes dwells. Though he remained a devout follower of Messmer after his flight from the Erdtree, he would rebel after learning of his liege's serpentine nature. His righteous stand was rewarded with imprisonment in an underground tomb. Black Knight Captain Huw Ashen remains in wh

Pay attention while he's in mid-air and watch out for the white smoke that will appear around him. As soon as you see the white smoke, get ready to dodge to avoid the impact of his landing. Sometimes, the area around him will explode as soon as he lands, so you need to do a second roll going forward, and then get a free hit while he's recovering. For the most part, you will want to stay close to him because of the long reach of his spear and flame spells. When you're fighting Messmer at a close range, you will have more chance of retaliating and chipping away at his health while he recovers. Engaging Messmer patiently is the best strategy to effectively take him down. When he finishes a string of attacks, focus on breaking his poise by pulling off heavy attacks for a chance to deal significant damage. Due to Messmer's speed, you need to approach him with the right mix of patience and aggressiveness. This boss can quickly transition between offense and defense by quickly disengaging with a leap after he finishes a move. Be aware that Messmer counters swiftly after sustaining damage, too. His speed and precision in combat are his biggest asset, requiring observation of his movements to avoid being overwhelmed. One of the basic moves that Messmer makes is the Flaming Spear Lunge , this is when you see him leap into the air as he thrusts his weapon and then crash on the ground with his spear engulfed in flames. This movement is dodgeable and will take some time to get used to but you can do this by rolling forward as he thrusts his weapon, waiting for the delay as he prepares to crash, and then rolling forward again to stay close to him. This allows you to attack him while he's recovering. Next up is Messmer's Flaming Assault , which is a 3-string attack where he combines this move with his flame spells. While the spear is engulfed in flames, he will cast spells with his flaming right hand and he will do the following attacks: When he swings his right arm, he will use a fire spell that affects the immediate area in front of him Quick Thrust with the spear, followed by a quick jump to reposition himself and another spear thrust Flame Spell where he twists in place to swing his spear and creates a flame surrounding him To dodge this move, you need to learn when he will do this by paying attention to his arm. If you see him cross it over and it's engulfed in flames, he will do this attack. To dodge, roll to the right if you're too close, otherwise, rolling backward is safe enough. You need to dodge as soon as he swings his arm engulfed in flames. For the second part, roll forward as soon as he thrusts with his spear, wait for the delay as he jumps to reposition himself, then dodge as soon as he lands on his new spot. Finally, for the last step, you can dodge this either going to the right, backward, or forward. It is recommended to roll forward so you can get close to him and get a free attack while he's recovering. Messmer's powerful Grab attack will kill most players instantly. It is important to dodge this attack to avoid an instant death. When Messmer's hand begins glowing, that is the sign he is about to grab you. Once he begins to descend his arm to grab you, roll either to the sides or forward. This will leave an opening to hit him. If you can break his stance, remember to go in front of him and just lightly press R1 (once) to do a light attack. This will do a critical hit and can deal a lot more damage than any attacks. sections.heading: Messmer The Impaler in Elden Ring DLC
sections.text: In one of the main pieces of artwork of Messmer the Impaler he is shown to be sitting on one of the thrones in Morgott the Omen King ’s arena, in the words of game director Hidetaka Miyazaki this symbolizes he is at least on equal terms to other demigods and children of Queen Marika . Part of the DLC will be exploring why the Lands of Shadow exists, as well as their relationship with this mysterious antagonist. Messmer, the Impaler did also feature prominently in the new Story Trailer released on May 21st. In said trailer, he is seen alongside his army, razing a city and setting it aflame, burning it to the ground.

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Messmer the Impaler
sections.text: Remembrance of the Impaler Remembrance of Messmer the Impaler, hewn into the Scadutree. ' The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. ' Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A malevolent snake writhed within Messmer, and so his very mother plucked out his eye and put in its place a seal of grace. Yet, having done so, her fear compelled her to secret away her child within the realm of shadow. Hidden away—keeping company with the original sin, and a hatred that would not be confined. Messmer's Helm Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents. Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's flame as well as Fire Knight skills. ' The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions. They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form, born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he. Messmer's Orb An incantation of Messmer the Impaler. Summons Messmer's flame to form a giant floating orb. The orb soars toward a foe, crashes into the earth, and explodes after a brief delay. Charging enhances potency. Messmer despised his own fire. Time and time again he hoped to rid himself of it, but ever did it burn. Messmer's Kindling The kindling that burned inside Messmer the Impaler. ' A dark thing, eaten away at by a wicked serpent. Burns the sealing tree said to be found at the old Rauh ruins. Messmer, much like his younger sister, bore a vision of fire. Fire Knight Armor Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Distinguished by its red cape and twin golden snakes which adorn the neck, enhancing incantations of Messmer's flame. These were the only ones who truly knew Messmer. His flames, like serpents. The painful fate that accompanied his accursed form. Winged Serpent Helm Helm of Kood, captain of the Fire Knights. A winged serpent perches atop it. Enhances Fire Knight skills. The winged serpent is the token creature of Messmer's military forces. It is a wise friend which keeps the base serpent at bay and holds its power in check. Blessing of Marika A special physick blessed by Marika, the queen of the Erdtree. Completely restores HP and heals all ailments. Marika once created several of these physicks for Messmer's sake. ' But never again. Serpent Crest Shield A finely-made "redshield" featuring an engraving of a winged serpent. Excels at guarding against fire. Said to have been made to commemorate the beginnings of the crusade started by Messmer, son of Marika. Messmer's Armor Black armor of Messmer the Impaler. ' Draped with a red cloak bearing his crest embroidered. On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired. "Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone." Black Pyrefly Fiery butterfly with black cinder wings. Material used for crafting items. Flies in war-torn lands that have been scoured by Messmer's flame. They burn in dark and slender ribbons of fire. Spear of the Impaler Weapon of Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. Remade by the forging arts of the realm of shadow, this weapon can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact. Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider Remembrance of Commander Gaius, hewn into the Scadutree. ' The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Both were as elder brothers to the lion, and both were cursed from birth. In spite of, or perhaps because of this very reason, ' Gaius was both Messmer's friend and the leader of his men. Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight Remembrance of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, hewn into the Scadutree. ' The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Once a Carian princess, Rellana disavowed her birthright and chose to stand at Messmer's side instead, knowing full well that not even the brilliance of the moon could grant him succor. Before long, she became known as the Sword of Messmer. Black Knight Commander Andreas Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. ' Use to summon the spirit of Andreas, Knight-Commander of the Black Knights. The Black Knights were the primary force of Messmer's army. Their first leader was Andreas, a man endowed with great strength and command over the powers of the Crucible, and whose spirit in these ashes dwells. Though he remained a devout follower of Messmer after his flight from the Erdtree, he would rebel after learning of his liege's serpentine nature. Recommended Scadutree Blessing: Level 14 (See Scadutree Fragment locations ) Recommended Summons: Redmane Knight Ogha , Greatshield Soldiers , Black Knife Tiche , Dung Eater Recommended Armaments: Black Knife , Rivers of Blood , Dragon Communion Seal , Carian Thrusting Shield Recommended Ashes of War: Bloodhound's Step , Lion's Claw Recommended Spells: Loretta's Mastery , Rotten Breath , Ekzykes's Decay , Swarm of Flies Recommended Talismans (not build dependant): Spelldrake Talisman 3 , (build dependant): Godfrey Icon , Great-Jar's Arsenal , Shard of Alexander Other items: Cerulean Hidden Tear , Opaline Bubbletear , Glovewort Crystal Tear , Melee Users Metyr, Mother of Fingers can be encountered in the Finger Ruins of Miyr , you may find her by entering the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and interacting with the throne. Follow the path to reach a bell to interact with that brings you to Metyr's arena. This boss deals Standard Damage and Magic Damage , she moves around quite slowly but will sometimes leap around to gain some distance. Metyr has a few attacks she does with her head, one of which is Kowtower's Resentment , where she raises her head until it starts to glow and then she smashes it onto the ground and after a moment, the ground will explode, this attack can be indicated when she raises her head briefly, the attack indicators show 7 lines in a cone shape from her head before they explode. You will be able to stand in between those lines or perform dodge rolls to get next to her to attack her there before she comes up. Another head attack of hers is her Gaze. While at a distance, her head will briefly glow and then shoot out a laser that covers a large range in the arena and deals heavy damage, this can be indicated when there are glowing rings around her head briefly before she shoots out her laser. You can avoid this attack by perfectly timing your dodge forward to get closer to her to attack her while you can. Metyr's arm attacks are pretty straightforward. The first attack is where she swings her arms one at a time in front of her, this can be indicated when she spreads her arms out before she attacks. This attack can be avoided by dodging backward when she spreads her arms out. The next attack is her Single Arm smashes. Metyr will lean towards one side with her head before she smacks down her arm, this can be indicated when she leans her head towards one side, it would take her a brief moment of leaning before she attacks. You can avoid this attack by dodging to either side so that you can attack her from there or dodge backward to avoid the attack all together. One of the Arm attack Combo is her Arm Ground Smashes. This is where Metyr will raise up both her arms and repeatedly hashing down onto the ground, the string attack will begin with her smashing the ground quickly with each arm, and then she will clasp her arms together, pause for a brief moment, and then smash the ground twice. To dodge this attack, you want to roll twice, just before the first arm hits the ground. This will dodge the first 2 quick arm smashes, then, pause here as you wait for her to clasp her arms together, and then roll backward, and then roll forward for the last 2 attacks. NOTE : There's a variation of this attack where she will do a 3rd arm smash at the end if you attack too fast! A few attacks that she uses with her body are her Body Smash , Spawning Leap , Jumping Smash , and Finger Spawn . Her Body Smash is when she brings her arms close to her as she lifts up her body holding it up briefly then slamming it back down onto the ground, this can be indicated when she holds her arms close to her as she goes up. You can easily avoid this attack by dodging to either side and then attacking her from the sides. Her Body Leap is where she will bring her arms to open up her chest made up of smaller fingers and leap over you as she releases smaller fingers onto you which deals damage to you as well, this can be indicated when she puts her hands to her chest and quickly leaps over you. When she leaps you can quickly dodge towards the sides to avoid the small fingers. Her Leaping Attack is when she slightly crouches down before leaping up and slamming back down several times and dealing heavy damage, this attack can be indicated when you see that she slightly crouches or when her legs bend. You can avoid this attack by getting as far from her as you can. Lastly, her Finger Spawn is when she will open up her chest to release three Lesser Fingercreepers to overwhelm you, it takes her a brief moment to summon them so when you see the Fingercreepers appear, you may get as far from her as possible to deal with them first before dealing with her. sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Metyr, Mother of Fingers
sections.text: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers Remembrance of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The mother of all Two Fingers and Fingercreepers was in turn a magnificently gleaming daughter of the Greater Will, and the first shooting star to fall upon the Lands Between. Staff of the Great Beyond Staff fashioned from the tail-fingers of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, and the microcosm raised aloft over the crux they form. Catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations. The Mother received signs from the Greater Will from the beyond of the microcosm. Despite being broken and abandoned, she kept waiting for another message to come. Fleeting Microcosm A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the secret hallowed rites. Conjures an image of a microcosm at a foe's feet that pulses with a single wave before disappearing in a burst. Charging enhances potency. The broken and discarded are fully willing to cling to fleeting simulacra, earning them some modicum of sympathy. Gazing Finger The head of Metyr, the finger-mother, wielded as a weapon without modification. From within the center of the fingerprint that wrinkles the creature's foremost protrusion, a tiny wart-like eye gazes vacantly into the beyond. Cherishing Fingers A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, aspiring mother of fingers. Surrounds the caster with a mesh of hefty fingers that wards all manner of projectiles, whether magical or physical in nature, away from the caster. Charging enhances potency. The dear fingers look after their mother, or perhaps that is merely what the mother wishes to believe. Cerulean Seed Talisman +1 A cerulean-colored talisman patterned after an Erdtree seed. Greatly boosts HP restoration from the Flask of Cerulean Tears. The Erdtree seed of this talisman was presumed to be an object of myth. This age-old artifact also depicts the Two Fingers, perhaps harkening back to the birth of the Erdtree. Finger Mimic Light-pink mushroom resembling a wizened finger. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. Used to by those who wish to become fingers to induce hallucinations. They call these mushrooms the stillborn of the Two Fingers. Fingerprint Nostrum Bolus engraved with whorl-like lines. Craftable item. Boosts mind, intelligence, faith, and arcane at the cost of gradual HP loss. A secret medicine of those who attempt to turn their human bodies into fingers. Ingesting causes something to wriggle within. Glinting Nail Nailstone with shining fingerprints floating above. Craftable item. Uses FP to fling a magic nail that crumbles during flight. The lampreys that guard the finger ruins resemble fingers far more than they do humans, and so the finger-weavers imitated their sorcery.

sections.text: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame Boss Video Guide Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame: Summons: Dung Eater Puppet , Mimic Tear to duplicate Hemorrhage effects (in your inventory) Armaments: Rivers of Blood , Bloodfiend's Arm , Great Stars , Anvil Hammer , Staff of the Guilty , Albinauric Staff , Misericorde Spells: Lucidity , Impenetrable Thorns , Swarm of Flies , Flame Protect Me , Ekzykes's Decay Skills: Lion's Claw , Savage Lion's Claw , Cragblade Talismans: Flamedrake Talisman +3 , Clarifying Horn Charm +2 Other items: Clarifying Boluses , Boiled Crab , Glovewort Crystal Tear Prone to Hemorrhage (Bleed): Use Blood Grease on Great Katana (Can also use Drawstring Blood Grease ) Stance can be broken: Two Full Heavy Hits Inflicting Bleed or Frost will cause him to stumble. This is not the same as Stagger, but provides a brief window to disengage, heal, or cancel his attack. Melee Users Midra is a challenging boss wielding a Greatsword covered in barbs, infused with the Frenzied Flame , making his attacks both unique and dangerous. The fight with Midra has two phases, with the second phase significantly more difficult due to his reliance on high-damage Frenzied Flame-based attacks. When you first enter the arena, you'll face Midra's human form, a " Wailing Man " armed with a stick. This initial form is much weaker than the main boss but can still cause significant damage through a grab attack or a madness AoE. It is crucial to deplete his health quickly to avoid these attacks. After defeating this form, there's a brief window before Midra transforms into his true form. Use this time to drink the Flask of Wondrous Physick to extend your buffs for the upcoming fight. Once the transformation is complete, Midra's true form is revealed, and the real challenge begins. His first move will likely be to summon Flame Strands that crawl toward you. To avoid this, time your forward roll just as the attack approaches, then delay a second roll to close the distance. This positioning allows you to land a heavy attack while Midra is recovering, as he is susceptible to being staggered. By carefully timing your moves and managing your buffs, you can turn the tide in this challenging fight against Midra. When at close range, Midra will begin swinging his greatsword at you. While he is a slow-moving boss, his attacks are quick and yet, predictable. One of his common attack strings is the Triple Greatsword Swing . He begins with a right overhead swing, followed by a left overhead swing, and ends it again with another right swing in quick succession. This attack can be dodged by going towards his weapon, so you should dodge going to your right, then left, and right again. At the end of this attack string, you should be able to land a heavy attack on him while he's recovering. For his second combo, he will pull off a 3-attack string that begins with 2 quick sweeps starting from the left, then right, and followed by a Dash Thrust . The final move in this combo allows him to dash forward which leaves a trail of flames. To dodge this move, roll backward twice for the quick sweeps, then roll forward as he finishes this move. This creates a distance between you and him, and from here, you can cast a spell if you have the FP for it. Another one of his combos is a 2-attack string where he begins with a left-side swing of his weapon and is followed by a Thrust with a short delay. For this attack, you can dodge by rolling to the left, and then towards him. If you do this successfully, you will be able to get behind him and land another heavy attack. The delay is something that needs to be learned so take your time with this. For the next melee move, you will notice Midra use the nail in his left hand and stab you with it. This Nail Stab attack varies with either a single stab or a double stab with a slight delay in between. To dodge this move, roll backward to dodge the first stab, and wait for a bit before you go in with an attack since he might follow up with another stab. One of Midra’s most powerful attacks is the Big Flame Explosion . He starts to use this once you reach the second phase when his health drops to about 70%. When you see him rise up above you, it’s a clear sign that the Big Flame Explosion is coming. Once you see him prepare this move, you want to run to the edge of the arena as there's no way of dodging it at close range. Failing to do so can result in high damage, potentially even a one-shot kill, so prioritizing distance is crucial. In the second phase, Midra will retain his original strings of attacks and will gain new ones. He can now cast a single Flame Strand that travels the same way as his opening attack, but instead of 2 Strands, there's only one here. You can dodge the same way you did previously. The next move begins with Midra firing up his greatsword. You can see the Frenzied Flame covering his weapon and he begins to do a right-step sweep followed clo

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
sections.text: Frenzied Burst Incantations originating from the maddening Three Fingers. Releases concentrated blasts of the yellow flame of frenzy from the caster's eyes. Charging enhances potency, enabling the blasts to penetrate the enemy's guard. In times past, every single person who attempted to control the flame of frenzy succumbed to madness after a desperate internal struggle. This incantation is testament to a meager victory. Frenzied Flame Seal Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame. This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence, and faith all together. Greatsword of Damnation Golden greatsword that once pierced the body of Midra, master of the manse. Used by the hornsent in the execution of a damnation like no other. The barbs that pierce the victim from within wind gently around the blade. Howl of Shabriri Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers. Releases a maddening shriek that causes madness buildup in foes nearby. This incantation also causes madness buildup in the caster and makes enemies more likely to target them. It is said that the sickness of the flame of frenzy began with Shabriri, the most reviled man in all history. Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [2] A record of crafting techniques left by a craftsman who served Midra, master of the manse, and Nanaya, its lady. His eyes were burned by the Flame of Frenzy. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Hefty Frenzied Flame Pot Map: Abyss Map of the abyss at the east of the Gravesite Plain. A thick forest sprawls at the depths of the ravine that is untouched even by sunlight. Known as the sanctum of Sage Midra, and is a region forbidden by the hornsent. Midra's Flame of Frenzy Incantation in praise of Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame. Summons an apparition of the Lord's head to spew frenzied flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. sections.text: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame Boss Video Guide Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame: Summons: Dung Eater Puppet , Mimic Tear to duplicate Hemorrhage effects (in your inventory) Armaments: Rivers of Blood , Bloodfiend's Arm , Great Stars , Anvil Hammer , Staff of the Guilty , Albinauric Staff , Misericorde Spells: Lucidity , Impenetrable Thorns , Swarm of Flies , Flame Protect Me , Ekzykes's Decay Skills: Lion's Claw , Savage Lion's Claw , Cragblade Talismans: Flamedrake Talisman +3 , Clarifying Horn Charm +2 Other items: Clarifying Boluses , Boiled Crab , Glovewort Crystal Tear Prone to Hemorrhage (Bleed): Use Blood Grease on Great Katana (Can also use Drawstring Blood Grease ) Stance can be broken: Two Full Heavy Hits Inflicting Bleed or Frost will cause him to stumble. This is not the same as Stagger, but provides a brief window to disengage, heal, or cancel his attack. Melee Users Midra is a challenging boss wielding a Greatsword covered in barbs, infused with the Frenzied Flame , making his attacks both unique and dangerous. The fight with Midra has two phases, with the second phase significantly more difficult due to his reliance on high-damage Frenzied Flame-based attacks. When you first enter the arena, you'll face Midra's human form, a " Wailing Man " armed with a stick. This initial form is much weaker than the main boss but can still cause significant damage through a grab attack or a madness AoE. It is crucial to deplete his health quickly to avoid these attacks. After defeating this form, there's a brief window before Midra transforms into his true form. Use this time to drink the Flask of Wondrous Physick to extend your buffs for the upcoming fight. Once the transformation is complete, Midra's true form is revealed, and the real challenge begins. His first move will likely be to summon Flame Strands that crawl toward you. To avoid this, time your forward roll just as the attack approaches, then delay a second roll to close the distance. This positioning allows you to land a heavy attack while Midra is recovering, as he is susceptible to being staggered. By carefully timing your moves and managing your buffs, you can turn the tide in this challenging fight against Midra. When at close range, Midra will begin swinging his greatsword at you. While he is a slow-moving boss, his attacks are quick and yet, predictable. One of his common attack strings is the Triple Greatsword Swing . He begins with a right overhead swing, followed by a left overhead swing, and ends it again with another right swing in quick succession. This attack can be dodged by going towards his weapon, so you should dodge going to your right, then left, and right again. At the end of this attack string, you should be able to land a heavy attack on him while he's recovering. For his second combo, he will pull off a 3-attack string that begins with 2 quick sweeps starting from the left, then right, and followed by a Dash Thrust . The final move in this combo allows him to dash forward which leaves a trail of flames. To dodge this move, roll backward twice for the quick sweeps, then roll forward as he finishes this move. This creates a distance between you and him, and from here, you can cast a spell if you have the FP for it. Another one of his combos is a 2-attack string where he begins with a left-side swing of his weapon and is followed by a Thrust with a short delay. For this attack, you can dodge by rolling to the left, and then towards him. If you do this successfully, you will be able to get behind him and land another heavy attack. The delay is something that needs to be learned so take your time with this. For the next melee move, you will notice Midra use the nail in his left hand and stab you with it. This Nail Stab attack varies with either a single stab or a double stab with a slight delay in between. To dodge this move, roll backward to dodge the first stab, and wait for a bit before you go in with an attack since he might follow up with another stab. One of Midra’s most powerful attacks is the Big Flame Explosion . He starts to use this once you reach the second phase when his health drops to about 70%. When you see him rise up above you, it’s a clear sign that the Big Flame Explosion is coming. Once you see him prepare this move, you want to run to the edge of the arena as there's no way of dodging it at close range. Failing to do so can result in high damage, potentially even a one-shot kill, so prioritizing distance is crucial. In the second phase, Midra will retain his original strings of attacks and will gain new ones. He can now cast a single Flame Strand that travels the same way as his opening attack, but instead of 2 Strands, there's only one here. You can dodge the same way you did previously. sections.heading: Elden Ring Mimic Tear Boss Guide
sections.text: Mimic Tear Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Mimic Tear Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Mimic Tear: Use the Lone Wolf Ashes Ash Summons or any Ashes if having difficulty Keep in mind that whatever build and equipment you choose to proceed with during this encounter will be mirrored. This will include the Armor , Weapons , Consumables , and Spells you are actively using. Unequip armors and weapons you have so the the Mimic will appear with nothing once you enter the arena, then after going through the yellow mist, you can start equipping your weapons and quickly make work of this boss fight. Like any human encounter, Status Effects are very effective. Melee Users Strategy: You could unequip your main weapon and catalyst/staff, the boss will have only their fists to attack you with. Then, spam your strongest poise breaking attack or backstab him for maximum damage. The Mimic Tear will then only transform when you approach close enough. If in co-op, this means you can keep a distance while another player focuses on clearing it. Without this method, this fight strategy will vary since the Mimic Tear is essentially a copy of you. You will have to keep in mind what your build is and fight according to your own weakness. Any healing items will also apply to the mimic tear so be mindful when distancing yourself as well. Magic and Ranged Users For Ranged Users, the strategy would be the same. If you're going in with Sorceries or Faith builds you can expect this boss to have the same. If you don't want to fight a boss with the same build as you, you will have to go in with a different set of equipped weapons before switching back. Summon/Co-Op Strategy The boss only transforms when the host gets within range of the boss while it's in its slime form. Therefore, by summoning a player, it's possible to cheese the boss. Summon a player into the game, go into the boss room, and do not go near the boss. Have the summoned player attack the boss while it's in slime form. The boss will have the normal health of a Silver Tear enemy, and will be much easier to kill. This method only works if the summon can 1-shot the boss while it's in slime form, but in this phase it has much lower HP. Note: It's possible to employ a similar strategy solo by 1-shotting the boss while staying out of it's range, using magic or some other means. All Users (Optional) Do NOT kill the Mimic Tear!: Since there are only 2 Mimic Tears in the Lands Between that don't respawn when killed and they copy all your equipment and skills, don't kill them and use them as practise, i.e. learning how to dodge or counter every Ash of War and spell in the game by not attacking and only focus on dodging it's attacks. Make sure you end your fight with the Mimic Tear by YOU dying and not the Mimic Tear. Be very wary if you have spells and/or Ashes of War that cause self-harm like Seppuku, since the Mimic Tear will eventually kill itself if the fight is prolonged. Mimic Tear Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Mimic Tear attacks are dependent on the player's equipped weapons and stats. They adjust accordingly to your own build. Mimic Tear Notes & Other Trivia Voice Actor: ?? Mimic Tear is a boss in a closed arena, that can die not from player direct hit (f.e. by using Seppuku Skill/Ash of War, Night Maiden's Mist sorcery or Fire's Deadly Sin incantation). Other Notes and Trivia Go Here Mimic Tear Weapon Oversights The Mimic Tear never uses the charged version of Thundercloud Form ( Dragon King's Cragblade Ash of War) for some reason. Other oversights involving weapon and Mimic Tear relationships go here.

sections.heading: Mimic Tear Lore in Elden Ring
sections.text: Mimic Tear is one of the many tragic but horrifying experiments led and conducted by the Eternal Cities of Nox. These monsters like the Silver Tear were the result of the attempts by the Eternal city of Nox to achieve their objective. Many of the items related to the creature states the target of the Eternal Cities has always been to "forge a lord". Whether that be a something defined as their very own version of an Elden Lord or something else. The Mimic Tear and other shapeshifter creatures like the Giant Silver Spheres mostly now inhabits the underground ruins of Nokron and Nokstella. Due to the civilization of the Eternal Cities being built underground, away from the Erdtree, the Golden Order, the Greater Will and the power of Queen Marika. They technologies are vastly more different or even unique compared to the ones the surface would have. These technologies that would lead to the creation of the beings like the Mimic Tear that has a common theme of shapeshifting. With Mimic Tears they have their ability in the copying of enemies one can speculate that the desire of the Eternal Cities looking for a lord even can be reflected on the mimic tear when they seek copy their adversary's capabilities. It is an assumption or the expressed version of hope. That in their best efforts, their technology, arts and magic best. It is a lonely, haunting reward, where the height of their achievements is to forever lose themselves in the image of those who possess the power they could never truly claim for their own.

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Mimic Tear
sections.text: Larval Tear An exceptionally rare creature that burgeons from spiritgraves and lives only a fleeting existence. Neither flesh nor spirit, but something in between. Material required by the amber egg cradled by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, to birth people anew. Being born anew allows the reallocation of attributes boosted by leveling up. Silver Tear Husk A hardened husk shed by a formless life form known as the Silver Tear, found in and around the Eternal City. Material used for crafting items. The Silver Tear makes mockery of life, reborn again and again into imitation. Perhaps, one day, it will be reborn a lord... Mimic Tear Ashes Legendary ashen remains. ' Use to summon the spirit of a mimic tear. ' Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. This spirit takes the form of the summoner to fight alongside them, but its mimicry does not extend to imitating the summoner's will. ' Mimic tears are the result of an attempt by the Eternal City to forge a lord.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Miranda the Blighted Bloom Boss Guide
sections.text: Miranda the Blighted Bloom Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Miranda the Blighted Bloom: Bring Neutralizing Boluses to cure Poison Use a Torch to light the Miranda on fire and interrupt most of its attacks Melee Users Be aggressive: you won't be able to avoid its poison cloud in such close quarters, so you'll need to kill it before the poison kills you. Alternate hits with a Torch to interrupt its attacks and a normal melee weapon to deal damage while it's recovering. If you deal damage quickly enough, you can largely ignore the Miranda Sprouts . Magic and Ranged Users Use spells that prioritize damage over casting speed: it's hard to avoid being poisoned, but the flower's attacks are mostly slow and unable to interrupt you. Inflict Fire Damage if possible—not only is the Miranda quite weak to it, it can interrupt its attacks. Just be sure to get out of the way when its Rain of Light attack starts charging up. Miranda the Blighted Bloom Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Poison Cloud The flower will slowly close its petals, before releasing a lingering cloud of pollen around it, causing rapid Poison build-up. Hit the Miranda with Fire Damage to interrupt this attack or burn up the pollen. Otherwise, there's no way to escape the cloud in the enclosed arena. Poison Cloud Burst A variation of the Poison Cloud attack, it will close its petals which shake slightly before unleashing a cloud of poisonous pollen in front of it, knocking its targets back and building up Poison. Roll away once you see it close its petals, or interrupt it with Fire Damage. This attack still does low amounts of damage if it connects, however. Rain of Light The flower rises high on its stalk before making an odd sound. The area around its intended target will begin glowing white, before being peppered with beams of light from above. Move away from the Miranda when you see it start to rise, then move back in when you see the motes. The attack's radius will be far enough away to give you space to keep attacking. Head Slam If its target is close to it, the flower will lean back and slam down on its foe, dealing mediocre damage. Interrupt the attack with Fire Damage or roll to either side. Miranda the Blighted Bloom Notes & Other Trivia Name changed to “ Miranda Blossom ” in an unknown patch.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Misbegotten Crusader Boss Guide
sections.text: Misbegotten Crusader Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Misbegotten Crusader Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Misbegotten Crusader: Use any fast rush down Ashes such as Oleg and Rollo , as it can be interrupted quite easily. While it is performing an attack, however, it gains massive hyper-armor and can breeze through the heaviest hits and connect. Melee Users This boss may look like any other Misbegotten boss and has a moveset similar to the Leonine Misbegotten , but it deals greater damage with additional Holy damage and with its attacks using the Golden Order Greatsword . It does a number of fast-moving aggressive attacks while advancing towards you. If you have a shield use it against these combo attacks while backing up. It will be even better if you have a shield that could defend against holy damage. When you have a chance, towards the end of the attack combos, roll through and toward the boss in order to deal a few hits. Use a combination of rolling in and attacking during the small windows, then immediately backing up again. You will especially have to look for its large AoE attacks which can occur within combo attacks. The main strategy here is to keep a defensive stance while preparing to dodge away and then quickly approach during each opening. Be conservative with your attacks until the boss is defeated. Magic and Ranged Users With a magic build, you may want to use quick-moving spells such as Glintstone Pebble or Glinstone Stars. Keep in mind that when you create distance, this boss quickly can close that distance with his quick lunges and could reach you with its holy ranged attacks. You will have to keep moving and constantly be prepared to dodge to the side. Attack sparingly and in between its attacks to avoid being unprepared for an incoming attack. Misbegotten Crusader Attacks & Counters See the Leonine Misbegotten page for a more complete and detailed guide on its moveset, as it shares most of the same attacks. Attack Description Counter Establish Order Stands up straight and raises its arms to the right, releasing a holy explosion. Afterward, it follows up with a wide-sweeping projectile. Run away to avoid the explosion, then dodge forward Misbegotten Crusader Notes & Other Trivia A crusader is one who fights for change, whether it be political, religious, or social. Since Misbegotten are widely regarded as heretical, this one may be fighting to protect them. This Misbegotten wields the Golden Order Greatsword , which was forged by King Consort Radagon . It was originally a sword gifted to him by his first wife, Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon . In the Japanese version of the game, internal files relating to the Misbegotten are named “Children of Radagon”. In the English version of the game (patch 1.00), the Winged Misbegotten was called a “Radagon chimera.” This may explain why Misbegotten Warriors have red hair like Radagon and how one managed to obtain the Golden Order Greatsword.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Mohg, Lord of Blood Boss Guide
sections.text: Mohg, Lord of Blood Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Mohg, Lord of Blood Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Mohg, Lord of Blood: The player can find the Mohg’s Shackle item in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds under Leyndell just before the Leyndell Catacombs Site of Grace at the bottom of the pipe/water area. Can be used similar to Margit’s Shackle during the boss fight to tether him for a short bit. You will NOT be able to tether him once he has reached the health threshold for second phase; use it while he is just above that to give yourself a generous window to burst him down. Mohg will recite Tres, Duo and Unus at certain health thresholds, placing a red ring around the player. At the start of his second phase, he will chant Nihil three times, doing large damage and healing himself for each ring on the player. In order to survive this attack, you will need a physick with the Purifying Crystal Tear , or will need to heal with crimson flasks. The damage will interrupt the player, so the optimal time to use the wondrous physick is before Mogh begins his phase transition countdown. The Purifying Crystal Tear will provide the player with a shield, which prevents all three counts of bleed in the mid-battle attack described above. This is obtained by defeating the NPC invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger . Equip fire and physical damage reduction to aid survival. The Lord of Blood's Exultation will provide a substantial damage boost for a lot of the fight, given the numerous hemorrhage opportunities on either side. If you can, aim to burst through his first phase as he takes his time counting down to the phase change. If you manage to stagger him before he actually uses Bloodboon Ritual, it's possible to kill him without seeing phase 2. One of his signature moves is "Bloodflame Talons," which involves a quick slash followed by an explosive burst. Players should roll away at the moment of detonation to avoid the attack. Another dangerous move is "Bloodboon," where Mohg launches a splash of bloodflame that ignites the ground and inflicts hemorrhage. This attack can come in a wide arc, a narrow cone, or a shower, depending on the situation. Mohg also employs spear attacks such as "Spear Swings," which consist of slow horizontal swipes that can be avoided by rolling forward with each swing. The "Thrust" involves a spear thrust into the ground, followed by a tug, which players can dodge by rolling past the thrust and attacking from behind. Mohg has airborne assaults like "Assault," where he throws bloodflame before charging, and "Blood Tax," which inflicts damage and builds hemorrhage. Players should roll to the sides to evade these attacks. Melee Users Mohg, Lord of Blood is a hard hitting boss with the capability of creating hostile environments that cause bleed buildup. However, he also has slow combos with plenty of openings for a melee user to take advantage of. Preparations One of Mohg's key mechanics is his Blood Curse mechanic. Throughout Phase 1 he applies up to three layers of Blood Curses on the player, and during the Phase 2 transition he uses the Blood Curses to drain HP from the player while simultaneously dealing massive bleed damage. The player can use the Purifying Crystal Tear in their Wondrous Physick to greatly mitigate this damage. Mohg also heavily relies on causing bleed buildup on the player with his bloodflame, especially during Phase 2. It is highly recommended the player boost their robustness and prepare consumables that will help mitigate bleed. Players can also obtain Mohg's Shackle to stun him twice during Phase 1. Mohg's Shackle has no effect during Phase 2. Upon entering the boss arena, the player has more than enough time to buff and use consumables before Mohg comes into attacking range. If the player wishes to maximize their buff duration, it is perfectly acceptable to start buffing after entering the fog gate. Phase 1 Most of Mohg's damage in Phase 1 comes from his trident's physical attacks, which are slow and telegraphed, giving players ample time to dodge and counterattack. However, Mohg's attack patterns often start similarly but end with different mixups, so it's crucial to stay alert. Generally, when Mohg steps back after a melee combo, it's a cue that his combo is over, making it safe to attack. For melee users with fast weapons, there are opportunities to land quick hits between his swings and then dodge the next attack. Slower weapon users, however, should wait until Mohg finishes his combo before attacking, as the delay between his attacks isn't long enough to swing and dodge safely. During this phase, Mohg also uses limited Bloodflame moves, such as throwing Bloodflame or casting Bloodflame Talons . While these spells cause bleed buildup, they're highly telegraphed, and players shouldn't expect significant bleed damage in Phase 1. Mohg also uses some limited Bloodflame movesets during this phase, mainly throwing Bloodflame at the player or using the Bloodflame T

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Mohg, Lord of Blood
sections.text: Regal Omen Bairn Doll of a curseborn bairn from the Erdtree's royal line. Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase down foes. Omen babies born of royalty do not have their horns excised, but instead are kept underground, unbeknownst to anyone, imprisoned for eternity. These memorial fetishes are fashioned in secret. Mohg's Shackle A fetish bathed in golden magic. ' Shackles were used to bind the accursed people called the Omen, ' and these ones were made to keep a particular Omen under ' strictest confinement. Though faint, the shackles still retain vestiges of power — enough ' to trap the once-bound Mohg on earth, if only for a short time. Cursed-Blood Pot Craftable item prepared using a ritual pot. Decorated with the crest of the Lord of Blood. Throw at enemies to douse them in accursed blood, causing summoned spirits to assail them with a rabid fervor. A childhood memory of the Lord of Blood. Bloodboon Sacred incantation of Mohg, Lord of Blood. Thrust arm into the body of the Formless Mother, then scatter the ' bloodflame to set the area ablaze. ' This incantation can be cast while in motion. The mother of truth craves wounds. When Mohg stood before ' her, deep underground, his accursed blood erupted with fire, and he was ' besotted with the defilement that he was born into. Mohg's Great Rune A Great Rune of the shardbearer Mohg. Its blessing grants a blessing of blood to summoned phantoms, and imparts a Phantom Great Rune upon successful invasion. Mohg and Morgott are twin brothers, and their Great Runes are naturally similar. But Mohg's rune is soaked in accursed blood, from his devout love for the wretched mire that he was born into far below the earth. Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound. Map (Mohgwyn Palace) Map of Mohgwyn Palace and environs. In the lightless depths lies the grave of an ancient civilization. It is here Mohg, the Lord of Blood, is building his palace, to be the seat of his coming dynasty named Mohgwyn. And whatever nightmares that may bring. War Surgeon Gown Bloodstained white gown of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. ' None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception. Lord of Blood's Exultation A talisman depicting the exultation of the Lord of Blood. Raises attack power when blood loss occurs in the vicinity. "Render up your offerings of blood to your Lord. Drench my consort's chamber. Slake his cocoon's thirst. His awakening shall herald the dawn of our dynasty." Pureblood Knight's Medal Proof that one is a glorious knight of the new Dynasty of Mohgwyn that the Lord of Blood will inaugurate. Use to be granted audience with Mohg. Only, it is not yet time. For Mohg yet slumbers beside the Divinity. Be Patient. The new dynasty is nigh. Remembrance of the Blood Lord Remembrance of Mohg, Lord of Blood, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Wishing to raise Miquella to full godhood, Mohg wished to be his consort, taking the role of monarch. But no matter how much of his bloody bedchamber he tried to share, he received no response from the young Empyrean. Ansbach's Attire Attire of Sir Ansbach. The embroidered crest of the Pureblood Knights has now all but faded away. Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills. Ansbach understood that keeping his oath to his old master was not an act of logic, nor would it bear any justice, but it was for these very reasons he was unable to let go.

sections.heading: Dialogue Related to Mohg, Lord of Blood
sections.text: Gideon Ofnir There are four more demigods yet to be located. Miquella of the Haligtree, the Unalloyed. His twin, Malenia, the undefeated swordswoman. Lunar Princess Ranni, daughter to Rennala. And the one only known as the Lord of Blood. Ranni is said to have cast aside her Great Rune, so here at the Hold, we seek the whereabouts of the remaining three shardbearers. If you should learn anything of these matters, I'll trade your findings for a hidden treasure, or a long-lost rite, known only to me. We both desire to stand before the Elden Ring, and become Elden Lord. As such, I hope we are compelled to work together. So. The Haligtree, now but a husk... I heard speculation Miquella embedded himself in the Haligtree, but before he could finish, someone cut the tree open and absconded with his infant form. Indeed, it seems those words held weight. How vexing. That the All-knowing didn't have the full story... Perhaps the Queen's sorrow was justified... Oh, so that's where the so-called Lord of Blood was hiding himself eh. A fitting little squat for that deluded maniac to bleat about the revival of his precious dynasty, while he turns our fellow Tarnished into Bloody Fingers. Let him stay there. That way, his delusions will remain as the are - distant and unattainable. But perhaps it's worth looking into... If what I've heard is right, then maybe... White Mask Varré I wish to anoint you a proper inductee. A knight to serve Luminary Mohg, the Lord of Blood, and establish a new dynasty. Luminary Mohg has strength, vision, and of course, love. So, what do you say, my lambkin? Now, take this. For your final trial. Soak the cloth with a maiden's blood. Normally, this ritual would involve killing one's own maiden, and recanting the wisdom of the Two Fingers. But since you are maidenless, the blood of anyone's maiden will do. Ahh, my lambkin. You've completed your final trial. And with this, you are a formal inductee. A knight who will assist Luminary Mohg, the Lord of Blood, in the establishment of a new dynasty. Now, give me your finger. This noble blood will be an immutable badge of honor, once it settles. Inside of you. Never forget that feeling of agony. For it is what binds you to Luminary Mogh, to all of us. Ha ha ha... A medal granted by the new Mohgwyn dynasty. ' With the power to grant audience with Luminary Mohg. ' I've gone out of my way to provide one to you. ' But you mustn't use it just yet. The meeting must wait until the Mohgwyn dynasty commences. ' Luminary Mohg yet slumbers beside the Divinity. ' We must endure a little longer. O... Luminary... Mohg... ' Please grant... the strength... you promised. ' I have given... everything... p' lease... my lord... p' lease, answer me... Luminary... Mohg. ' ... ' A-ahh... ' Bless the Mohgwyn Dynasty, with love! Sir Ansbach I am Ansbach. Formerly in service to Lord Mohg. But now, like you, another soul guided by Kindly Miquella. I ‘m hardly the steady hand I once was. My fighting days are far behind me. Kindly Miquella has discarded his Great Rune. The fog that vexed my aging faculties has been lifted. And follies better left forgotten haunt me once again. Once, in an attempt to free Lord Mohg from his enchantment, I challenged Tender Miquella, only to have my own heart rather artfully stolen. I knew not how weak I was. I believed that with sufficient mastery, even an Empyrean would be within reach of my blade. I could not have been more mistaken… Miquella the Kind...is a monster. Pure and radiant, he wields love to shrive clean the hearts of men. There is nothing more terrifying. After Lord Mohg's slaying at his dynastic palace, it appears his body has been absconded with. And taken straight to Kind Miquella. Surely you recall that I once served Lord Mohg as a Pureblood Knight. After failing him in every regard, and losing sight of my vows, I'd do anything to make amends, in whatever meagre way I can. What could they possibly have in mind for Lord Mohg's remains? The implications are rather… unnerving. Even the truth was itself mere folly. As if using Lord Mohg to gain entrance to the land of shadow were not enough, he plans to use his corpse as the vessel of his king consort. He has forsaken Lord Mohg's soul. He desires only his empty shell. It beggars belief, but… I'm afraid Tender Miquella fails to grasp the humiliation implied by this act. One thing is certain. My dear lord deserved better.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Mohg, the Omen Boss Guide
sections.text: Mohg, the Omen Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Mohg, the Omen Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Mohg, the Omen: Bring Mohg's Shackle Item Switch to Occult Affinities (Arcane users) Melee Users Equip Mohg's Shackle in your items and buff before entering the arena, summon your ash of choice right away then wait for him to approach. When he is close and about to strike, use the Mohg's shackle item to interrupt him then unleash some charged attacks on him. You may need to trade a hit or two, but you should be able to stagger him with all of that time and get a critical strike. Feel free to run away and rebuff if needed, let your summon take aggro and dodge through his attacks. Land a charged attack while he is busy with your summon then immediately use the Mohg's Shackle again--note that you can only use it TWICE each time you fight him. Then land some heavy or charged attacks afterward. It should be easy to stagger him at this point and now you get to face him with substantially less health. From here on just read his attacks and throw out some light attacks in between or run and gun if you would like to (the pillars can stop his bloodsplatter ability if they aren't knocked down yet). It might be tricky to get down but with the hammer talisman and the flask of wondrous physick that buffs charged attacks+stance break, I was able to break his stance with a straight sword, one-handed. Magic and Ranged Users For magic and ranged users, you need to be careful when casting spells/incantations or using ranged skills, his trident has a long reach and can clip you where you think you might not get hit. He also has a couple of bloodflame spells that can be used as projectiles. Try casting spells/incantations that are quick or heavy-hitting and make sure you're either at a safe distance, or when he's casting a spell as well, but do not trade blows with him when he's casting a spell as it is not worth it. Only do so if you think you're safe, you can take advantage of the pillars from the area to hide from the projectile. If you're using a bow and arrow, you can safely jump and shoot from a safe distance while kiting him around the area. You can also use Mohg's Shackle then cast the spell/incantation of your choice, note that you can only use the shackle twice each time you fight him. A good spell for this fight is Triple Rings of Light as it can be fired in rapid succession. Cast it with Dryleaf Seal or equip it in your off-hand. Also, it's damage can be buffed by Aura and Body buffs such as Golden Vow (Spell) and Howl of Shabriri . Alternatively, prepare your Flask of Wondrous Physick with the Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear and Cerulean Hidden Tear (to boost your magic dmg and make spells cost no FP) and equip Azur's Glintstone Crown for Comet Azur boost. Make 2-3 steps into the boss room and cast Terra Magica. As there is no fog gate advance a little forward to initiate the fight and after Mohg appears get back to Terra Magica area, drink the Wondrous Physick and start casting Comet Azur. The laser is long enough to reach him from where you stand. If Mohg starts to do his chanting first, you'll begin firing right as he finishes his chant. It has a bit of an RNG to it as to what he decides to do and can one-shot you if he stops to throw blood, but if he just slowly walks toward you, he'll be dead within seconds, even with his 47% magic absorb. Since he is one of the bosses who don't dodge out of harm's way, this is a fully working strategy here. Mohg, the Omen Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Trident thrust attack He will Thrust his trident in your direction (possibly can be triggered when you heal haven't tested theory) Get out of reach, block, or dodge Bloodboon Mohg will reach into the air and then toss a splash of bloodflame. This can come in a wide arc, narrow cone, or in a shower at his position. The floor where this attack contacts will light in bloodflame, dealing fire damage and contributing to hemorrhage buildup. The wide arc variant is used at medium range and can be evaded by rolling forward. Roll to the side to avoid the cone variant. Get behind him to punish the shower variant. Trident combos He has a triple swing combo, a swing then ground stab combo, and a swing + overhead slam combo Watch his trident. The moment it moves dodge through the swipe and prepare to dodge the next 1-2 swings until he does a heavier attack and stops. When he stabs the ground and you are knocked down--don't immediately get up, there is a hitbox when he pulls out the trident! You can watch the trident to see if he plans on attacking again right after or if he is going to use a spell instead. Bloodlfame Talons Mohg will slash the air near him with his left hand, before it explodes. The slash itself is less harmful than the explosion. Roll away right before it detonates. Be careful if you're aggressively rolling forward into his trident attacks as he can use this attack to roll-catch you. Mohg, the Omen Notes & Other
