sections.heading: Elden Ring Red Wolf of Radagon Boss Guide
sections.text: Red Wolf of Radagon Boss Video Guide Red Wolf of Radagon Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Red Wolf of Radagon: Use a spirit ash with high defense, like Spirit Jellyfish Ashes , to allow you to get in hits more reliably and whittle away its relatively low health Use fast-castling spells like Glintstone Pebble and stay mobile Use Marionette Soldier Ashes to pepper it with arrows and make it dash over and over, giving you time to get in hits safely from range Use Barricade Shield to block its larger attacks without breaking your guard Melee Users Bait and Slash: Stay reactive and don't get greedy. Wait for attacks with long recovery times like Rearing Bite, Blade Plunge, and Glintstone Cometshard, nail the dodges, and get in only as many hits as you can afford before going back on the defensive. Experiment to figure out whether your weapon deals more damage with a few quick hits or one charged heavy attack. Don't bother attacking if there are Magic Glintblades active, or you're likely to take more damage than you inflict. Turtle Up: All of the Red Wolf's melee attacks deal Physical damage, so if you're good at stamina management you can get a lot of mileage out of a shield with 100% Physical reduction. Try to keep your shield up as often as possible as long as you've got the stamina for it, since its Bite attacks can come out of nowhere and cover a surprising amount of distance. Check the combo chart to see when it's safe to get in a guard counter and try to build towards breaking its considerable stance. Magic and Ranged Users Baby in a Corner: The Red Wolf will usually dodge ranged attacks, so try to maneuver it into a corner to limit its range of motion. Take advantage of the windups for its attacks to get in hits, but be ready to dodge those attacks as soon as you're done casting. Magical Melee: Ignore its ranged dodges entirely by using close-range spells rather than projectiles. Follow one of the melee strategies, but instead of attacking with physical weapons use spells like Carian Slicer or Catch Flame . Weapons that deal physical damage but scale on Intelligence and Faith, like Rosus' Axe or Winged Scythe , are even more effective due to the Red Wolf's high elemental resistance. Red Wolf of Radagon Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Bite Steps forward and bites at the player Roll forward, step back, or guard Rearing Bite Rears up on its hind legs, then plunges its head down and forward while biting Roll forward and attack during its long recovery Leaping Bite Leaps forward and bites, then lands on the other side of the player and pivots 180° to face them Roll forward as its head starts to descend Golden Blade Summons a magical golden sword and swings it in wide arcs Roll in the direction the blade is swinging or guard. This deals Standard damage, so it can also be safely blocked with a shield with 100 Physical reduction. Some variations of this attack have very long windups, giving players plenty of time to back away Blade Plunge Summons its sword, leaps high into the air in a corkscrew motion, then slams the sword down on the ground Roll forward as it begins to fall and get in a hit during the long recovery Magic Glintblade Moves a short distance left or right, creating a magical orb as it goes. Shortly afterwards, this orb fires a single magical glintblade at you Keep moving to the side and the glintblade will miss you, so focus on dodging until it's gone Glintblade Dash Dashes to the left or right, leaving three Magic Glintblades as it goes As above, just keep moving until all the glintblades have fired and missed. It will keep attacking you after they're created, so focus on evading until you're no longer under double threat Glintstone Cometshard Jumps into the air and shoots a large magical projectile Run forward when you see it jump and you can run underneath the cometshard and attack after it lands, or else roll forward when it's at the apex of its jump : Attack can be spell parried Red Wolf of Radagon Lore, Notes & Other Trivia Red Wolf of Radagon is heavily inspired by an unused concept for a boss fight concept from Dark Souls 3 related to Old Wolf of Farron Follows a trend of large wolf bosses in Souls games, Great Grey Wolf Sif and Gravetender Greatwolf Bug: If wolf lands on globe above him and try to jump back on the field of battle, it will die due to gravity fall.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Red Wolf of the Champion Location
sections.text: From the beginning of Gelmir Hero's Grave, head down the first chariot hall and fall of the ledge after passing a Skeletal Archer to your right. Climb the ladder in this alcove, then head north to the fog gate leading to the Red Wolf of the Champion. Map Link

sections.heading: Elden Ring Regal Ancestor Spirit Boss Guide
sections.text: Additional Fight Strategy Once its health is getting low after its first two Soul Siphons, go all out and try to kill it before it can heal again Additional Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter The Regal Ancestor Spirit shares most of its attacks and counters with the Ancestor Spirit Rebirth Collapses to the floor and fades away, then emerges anew from a spirit deer elsewhere in the arena. Phase 2 : Emerges from either a boar or a springhare. Phase 3 : Can emerge from a goat. Afterwards, it will perform one of three attacks depending on what animal it emerged from. Keep hitting it while it vanishes, then use the time to heal or renew your buffs Phase 2 Soul Siphon The first time it goes below 50% HP, the spirit begins glowing and heals 50% of its health while dealing damage in a small radius around it. This begins Phase 2 Phase 3 : Once it goes below 40% HP in Phase 2, it will use Soul Siphon again, heal 30% of its health, and begin Phase 3. Future Soul Siphons will only heal 15% of its health, and it will always try to heal once it goes below 10% HP Run away when it starts glowing, or alternatively tank the damage and keep attacking Springhare Hop Releases a high-pitched squeal, before rising onto its hind legs. It then hops towards the target up to three times creating a small shockwave when it lands. Only used when its most recent Rebirth emerged from a springhare Run in a wide circle around it Boar Charge Squeals like a boar, lowers its antlers to the ground, and charges forward at high speeds. Only used when its most recent Rebirth emerged from a boar Dodge towards it as it draws close to you Phase 3 Goat Roll Bleats like a goat, then curls into a ball and rolls forward, continuing until it hits its target or it gives up. Much like a Godskin Noble, this attack can last very long. Only used when its most recent Rebirth emerged from a goat. Move to the side while it's curling up, then chase after it while it rolls Regal Ancestor Spirit Notes & Other Trivia Once the boss is defeated, you can leave by interacting with a white light in the middle of its arena. This light can be hard to spot due to the size of the arena, but won't miss it if you start with your back to the boss door and move forward A glitch may occur with this boss, where it will instantly die from falling out of the map The spirit anatomically has more in common with a horse than it does with a deer: it has only a single toe on each foot and its jaw is similar to that of a horse Although thematically its Soul Siphon drains life from the animal spirits on the battlefield, in fact the amount it heals only depends on how often the move has been been used and not whether the animals or any other targets are within its area of effect. The Spirit has an unused move where its antlers grow even larger after it emerges from a deer

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Regal Ancestor Spirit
sections.text: Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor Spirit, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Ancestral spirits exist as a phenomenon beyond the purview of the Erdtree. Life sprouts from death, as it does from birth. Such is the way of the living. Ancestral Spirit's Horn Item cut from the horns of the Regal Ancestor Spirit. Restore FP upon defeating enemies. A number of new growths bud from the antler-like horns of the fallen king, each glowing with light. Thus does new life grow from death, and from death, one obtains power. Shining Horned Headband Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns. Worn by ancestral follower shamans. Horns with buds that also shine are ideal ceremonial items for ancestral worship. Strengthens Ancestral Infant's Head.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Rellana, Twin Moon Knight Boss
sections.text: This is an optional boss. She can be bypassed via the sealed Spritspring in Gravesite Plain to enter Scadu Altus. Closest Site of Grace: Castle Lord's Chamber. Patch 1.13 removed Dryleaf Dane 's summon sign for this boss.

After defeating this enemy, use the elevator behind it to go up and use the Castle-Lord's Chamber Site of Grace to your right. You will find the mist door to this boss in the next hallway to your left. Map Link [ Video Link ]

sections.heading: Elden Ring Rellana, Twin Moon Knight Boss Guide
sections.text: Rellana, Twin Moon Knight Boss Video Guide Shadow of the Erdtree Bosses Ranked Rellana, Twin Moon Knight Fight Strategy Fight Overview Rellana is one of the hardest bosses that you will encounter in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree, with a particular focus on brutal boss design. She combines swift and aggressive melee attacks, often with short reaction time, with ranged magic spells to form a very deadly arsenal for both new and veteran players. Once she enters Phase 2, her combo attacks deal extra magic and fire damage, she gets new, optional extensions to her combo strings, and can add addtional attacks to final blows, allowing her to deal large amounts of damage per hit to an already fast paced boss fight and reducing the margin for error, as one late dodge or instance of panic rolling can cost you the attempt. The Best Tips for Rellana, Twin Moon Knight: Recommended Spirit Ashes: Greatshield Soldiers , Black Knife Tiche , Mimic Tear , Black Knight Commander Andreas Recommended Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes , Giant Hunt , Wing Stance Recommended Spells: Rotten Breath , Swarm of Flies , Lightning Spear , Barrier of Gold Bring the Spelldrake Talisman (+3) to reduce Magic Damage, it can be found in Castle Ensis. Also recommended to craft Spellproof Dried / Pickled Liver . There is a pool of water in the center of arena, so it's recommended to bring some weapons that can deal Lightning Damage . Melee Users You can use a Shield or dodge roll to either side to protect yourself from incoming physical damage. The key to winning is patience. You can summon Mimic Tear to fight alongside you or opt to summon Leda. It is recommended to only have 1 Summon so the boss will not have a dramatic increase in health pool. Beware that the NPC summon enacts a general debuff that will affect the player. The boss's long variable combos make it difficult to get near her to launch your attack, but the player should particularly observe her ' Forward Thrust Combos' , as they often provide the best punish windows.: 3-string attack combo: she slices each weapon once and ends with Double Thrust with both light greatswords. 6-string attack combo: she starts with an upward Thrust with each weapon, followed by one spinning attack, a quick thrust with each weapon, and ends with another Double Thrust. The key to determining the end of her attack patterns is when she does the move slow. If it's fast, there's a big chance that it will be followed up by a slow attack, then if it's slow (or heavy) then, you can go in for an attack as she recovers. When you see an opening, opt for a heavy attack for a chance to stagger her. The second phase of the fight begins when her health drops below 50%. Rellana will infuse her Greatswords with Glintstone and Flame elements. The greatswords will glow blue and orange. The boss becomes more dangerous and the moves become more difficult to dodge. The dodge frames become shorter and the AoE of skills become larger. Fire. The flame element creates the widest AoE when using the Sleight of Sword - Fire. This also creates smaller rings of fire in the outer AoE but they don't deal as much damage in the center of the skill. Ideally, you can roll backward three times to get yourself out of the area. Make sure to pay attention to the outer rings as you run to safety. Magic. When you see her cast the huge Magical Greatsword, be prepared for the first downward vertical slash, this is immediately followed by a giant horizontal spin slash that reaches nearly the entire room. Make sure to dodge early for this attack because it has a deceptively wide reach. Roll forward to get a free hit on her if you get the timing right. Another spell that she can use is the Glintblade Slicer that she uses when you're far away from her. This is an attack where she swings her weapon downward and sends a blue arc that tracks your movements. The arc varies in position, others are vertical, horizontal, or slanted. To dodge the Glintblade Slicer , you can run away to the left for the first two (if you're far enough), then dodge roll twice for the 3rd and 4th slicer, and then, go for a forward roll for the 5th one. This will allow you to close the gap. After a while, this boss will use Twin Moons , which protects them from incoming damage and is closely followed by a plunge attack. If you get hit by the falling moon, you will get stunned and you will not be able to roll away to avoid further damage. The Pearldrake Talisman will reduce incoming Elemental Damage. Sometimes she will use Twin Moons at at close range or she will jump away to execute it. The distance will not make much of a change since you still need to jump or dodge roll (any direction) at the exact time the moon hits the ground. Te move is dodgeable. As the fight comes to an end, the boss will alternate between Physical and Elemental Attacks. Always pay attention to her light greatswords, because this will tell you what her next move is. Magic and Ranged Users Sorcery user

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
sections.text: Carian Thrusting Shield Silver thrusting shield embedded with glintstones. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. Once wielded by Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, during her sole entry into ritual combat—a demonstration of fidelity to the Erdtree. High Priest Hat The hat of Count Ymir, High Priest. The circular design at the top represents the Greater Will and its lightless abyss, imparting increased intelligence and arcane to the wearer. Though Count Ymir instructed Rellana in the sorcerous arts, he abandoned his allegiance to the moon. "It was merely the closest of the celestial bodies. Nothing more." Rellana's Armor Ornate armor of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel. Adorned with the lapis-lazuli blue that is symbolic of Caria, its radiance is yet to fully fade. Rellana's Cameo Talisman featuring a gallant portrait of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight. Enhances attacks executed after maintaining the same stance for a certain length of time. Engraved as a reminder of the unparalleled devotion of those who left their homelands to serve Rellana. "By your leave, we will accompany you wherever your lunar vessel takes you." Rellana's Helm Ornate helm of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel. Rennala, head of the royal family of Caria, was said to have given her younger sister, who renounced her lineage to chase after Messmer, a gift of lustrous black hair. sections.text: This is an optional boss. She can be bypassed via the sealed Spritspring in Gravesite Plain to enter Scadu Altus. Closest Site of Grace: Castle Lord's Chamber. sections.heading: Elden Ring Rellana, Twin Moon Knight Boss Guide
sections.text: Rellana, Twin Moon Knight Boss Video Guide Shadow of the Erdtree Bosses Ranked Rellana, Twin Moon Knight Fight Strategy Fight Overview Rellana is one of the hardest bosses that you will encounter in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree, with a particular focus on brutal boss design. She combines swift and aggressive melee attacks, often with short reaction time, with ranged magic spells to form a very deadly arsenal for both new and veteran players. Once she enters Phase 2, her combo attacks deal extra magic and fire damage, she gets new, optional extensions to her combo strings, and can add addtional attacks to final blows, allowing her to deal large amounts of damage per hit to an already fast paced boss fight and reducing the margin for error, as one late dodge or instance of panic rolling can cost you the attempt. The Best Tips for Rellana, Twin Moon Knight: Recommended Spirit Ashes: Greatshield Soldiers , Black Knife Tiche , Mimic Tear , Black Knight Commander Andreas Recommended Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes , Giant Hunt , Wing Stance Recommended Spells: Rotten Breath , Swarm of Flies , Lightning Spear , Barrier of Gold Bring the Spelldrake Talisman (+3) to reduce Magic Damage, it can be found in Castle Ensis. Also recommended to craft Spellproof Dried / Pickled Liver . There is a pool of water in the center of arena, so it's recommended to bring some weapons that can deal Lightning Damage . Melee Users You can use a Shield or dodge roll to either side to protect yourself from incoming physical damage. The key to winning is patience. You can summon Mimic Tear to fight alongside you or opt to summon Leda. It is recommended to only have 1 Summon so the boss will not have a dramatic increase in health pool. Beware that the NPC summon enacts a general debuff that will affect the player. The boss's long variable combos make it difficult to get near her to launch your attack, but the player should particularly observe her ' Forward Thrust Combos' , as they often provide the best punish windows.: 3-string attack combo: she slices each weapon once and ends with Double Thrust with both light greatswords. 6-string attack combo: she starts with an upward Thrust with each weapon, followed by one spinning attack, a quick thrust with each weapon, and ends with another Double Thrust. The key to determining the end of her attack patterns is when she does the move slow. If it's fast, there's a big chance that it will be followed up by a slow attack, then if it's slow (or heavy) then, you can go in for an attack as she recovers. When you see an opening, opt for a heavy attack for a chance to stagger her. The second phase of the fight begins when her health drops below 50%. Rellana will infuse her Greatswords with Glintstone and Flame elements. The greatswords will glow blue and orange. The boss becomes more dangerous and the moves become more difficult to dodge. The dodge frames become shorter and the AoE of skills become larger. Fire. The flame element creates the widest AoE when using the Sleight of Sword - Fire. This also creates smaller rings of fire in the outer AoE but they don't deal as much damage in the center of the skill. Ideally, you can roll backward three times to get yourself out of the area. Make sure to pay attention to the outer rings as you run to safety. Magic. When you see her cast the huge Magical Greatsword, be prepared for the first downward vertical slash, this is immediately followed by a giant horizontal spin slash that reaches nearly the entire room. Make sure to dodge early for this attack because it has a deceptively wide reach. Roll forward to get a free hit on her if you get the timing right. Another spell that she can use is the Glintblade Slicer that she uses when you're far away from her. This is an attack where she swings her weapon downward and sends a blue arc that tracks your movements. The arc varies in position, others are vertical, horizontal, or slanted. To dodge the Glintblade Slicer , you can run away to the left for the first two (if you're far enough), then dodge roll twice for the 3rd and 4th slicer, and then, go for a forward roll for the 5th one. This will allow you to close the gap. After a while, this boss will use Twin Moons , which protects them from incoming damage and is closely followed by a plunge attack. If you get hit by the falling moon, you will get stunned and you will not be able to roll away to avoid further damage. The Pearldrake Talisman will reduce incoming Elemental Damage. Sometimes she will use Twin Moons at at close range or she will jump away to execute it. The distance will not make much of a change since you still need to jump or dodge roll (any direction) at the exact time the moon hits the ground. Te move is dodgeable. As the fight comes to an end, the boss will alternate between Physical and Elemental Attacks. Always pay attention to her light greatswords, because this will tell you what her next move is. sections.heading: Results of Defeat on World
sections.text: Although Ranni the Witch intervenes to defend Rennala in Phase 2, defeating this boss will not fail Ranni's questline. Defeating this boss will give you the option to Rebirth your character in exchange for Larval Tears . See the Rennala (NPC) page for more info. Enia will become available in the Roundtable Hold if Rennala is the first Great Rune boss the Tarnished has defeated.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon Boss Guide
sections.text: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon Boss Video Guide Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon: Get around her extremely high Magic negation by: Using Rock Sling , which deals Physical damage Using a melee weapon that scales with Intelligence , such as Carian Knight's Sword or Moonveil Summon Lone Wolf Ashes in Phase 2 to stagger her repeatedly Inflict status effects to get past Phase 1 quickly Use Throwing Daggers in Phase 1 to hit the glowing Juvenile Scholars Melee Users Phase 1 : This phase is straightforward if you stay alert and avoid the room's hazards. Consider using a fast-attacking weapon, like Fists , to quickly hit the Juvenile Scholars, as a single hit stops them from reinforcing Rennala's bubble. Once Rennala begins to fall, switch back to your main weapon and charge a heavy attack to strike as soon as she becomes vulnerable. Continue your assault until you notice her starting to glow, signaling the need to retreat to avoid her powerful Light Explosion. Phase 2 : Melee players have an advantage here since Rennala is vulnerable to physical damage and staggers easily. Focus on landing consecutive hits with a lighter weapon to disrupt most of her attacks without draining too much stamina. When she retreats or if you need to recover stamina, roll through her magic before re-engaging. Be wary of her summons — block or dodge them and wait for them to disappear before resuming your attack. Keep Rennala in sight, as she will continue attacking while her summons are active. Magic and Ranged Users Rennala has high Magic negation, so it's best to use a melee weapon that scales with Intelligence or Faith and approach this as a melee fight. If you prefer casting spells, Rock Sling is effective due to its physical damage, but you'll also want a faster spell like Glintstone Pebble for dealing with the Juvenile Scholars in Phase 1 . Incantation users have a slight advantage since Rennala's elemental negations are only moderately high, but they should still consider Bestial Incantations for their physical damage. In Phase 2 , maintain distance from Rennala to avoid most of her attacks by running rather than rolling. Look for openings after her attacks to charge your spells. When she summons, focus on avoiding damage and wait for the summon to dissipate before resuming your attacks. sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
sections.text: Stargazer Heirloom A talisman engraved with the legend of a queen. Raises intelligence. The young astrologer gazed at the night sky as she walked. She had always chased the stars every step of her journey. Then she ' met the full moon — and, in time, the astrologer became a queen' . Rennala's Full Moon Sorcery associated with the Carian queen. Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes. Queen Rennala encountered this enchanting moon when she was young, and later, it would bewitch the academy' . Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. In her youth, Rennala was a prominent champion who charmed the academy with her lunar magic, becoming its master. She also led the Glintstone Knights and established the house of Caria as royalty' . Carian Knight Helm Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family. Carian Knight's Sword Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty. These knights' swords could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle' . Dark Moon Greatsword A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments. sections.text: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon Boss Video Guide Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon: Get around her extremely high Magic negation by: Using Rock Sling , which deals Physical damage Using a melee weapon that scales with Intelligence , such as Carian Knight's Sword or Moonveil Summon Lone Wolf Ashes in Phase 2 to stagger her repeatedly Inflict status effects to get past Phase 1 quickly Use Throwing Daggers in Phase 1 to hit the glowing Juvenile Scholars Melee Users Phase 1 : This phase is straightforward if you stay alert and avoid the room's hazards. Consider using a fast-attacking weapon, like Fists , to quickly hit the Juvenile Scholars, as a single hit stops them from reinforcing Rennala's bubble. Once Rennala begins to fall, switch back to your main weapon and charge a heavy attack to strike as soon as she becomes vulnerable. Continue your assault until you notice her starting to glow, signaling the need to retreat to avoid her powerful Light Explosion. Phase 2 : Melee players have an advantage here since Rennala is vulnerable to physical damage and staggers easily. Focus on landing consecutive hits with a lighter weapon to disrupt most of her attacks without draining too much stamina. When she retreats or if you need to recover stamina, roll through her magic before re-engaging. Be wary of her summons — block or dodge them and wait for them to disappear before resuming your attack. Keep Rennala in sight, as she will continue attacking while her summons are active. Magic and Ranged Users Rennala has high Magic negation, so it's best to use a melee weapon that scales with Intelligence or Faith and approach this as a melee fight. If you prefer casting spells, Rock Sling is effective due to its physical damage, but you'll also want a faster spell like Glintstone Pebble for dealing with the Juvenile Scholars in Phase 1 . Incantation users have a slight advantage since Rennala's elemental negations are only moderately high, but they should still consider Bestial Incantations for their physical damage. In Phase 2 , maintain distance from Rennala to avoid most of her attacks by running rather than rolling. Look for openings after her attacks to charge your spells. When she summons, focus on avoiding damage and wait for the summon to dissipate before resuming your attacks. sections.heading: Elden Ring Romina, Saint of the Bud Location
sections.text: Romina, Saint of the Bud can be found in Church of the Bud. You can get to the Church of the Bud by heading to the top floor of the western-most square building in the Rauh Ancient Ruins Map Link . From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace , go southwest into the building. From the top of the stairs, go roughly straight ahead to the exit to outdoors. Go north across the watery outdoor area. To the north is an entrance to a room with red rot and red Lesser Kindred of Rot enemies. Find the lift on the left wall a short way into the room. If the lift is raised, it will look like a solid stone wall and may be easy to miss. Take the lift up then go up the inside central stairs and you'll emerge at the The Church of the Bud. <br> Alternative Route: from Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace. Go partly down the stairs to about midway between the site of grace and the Archer Golem . To the north you will see one of several circular shaped gazebos down on a lower landscape level far under the stairs, where there is also is water and 2 yellow armored knights. The gazebo midway between the site of grace and the Golem will allow you to double jump onto it with Torrent from the stairs without any fall damage. The correct jumping point is right near the join between the stairs and a flat section of the stairs path. Double jump from the stairs to the gazebo, and then safely to the ground. Then go north, pass the yellow knights, pass the other gazebo, and go into a red rot-filled interior. In the rot-filled room on the left wall is a block-shaped lift near some red Lesser Kindred of Rot enemies . Take the lift up, then go up the central stairs to get to the Church of the Bud.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Romina, Saint of the Bud Boss Guide
sections.text: Romina, Saint of the Bud Boss Video Guide Romina, Saint of the Bud Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Romina, Saint of the Bud: Recommended summons: Mimic Tear , Black Knife Tiche Recommended armaments: Barbed Staff-Spear , Royal Greatsword Recommended spells: Flame, Cleanse Me , Swarm of Flies , Impenetrable Thorns , Frozen Lightning Spear , Dragonice Recommended talismans: Sacred Scorpion Charm , Lightning Scorpion Charm , Godfrey Icon , Immunizing Horn Charm Bring Preserving Boluses , can be crafted by finding the Armorer's Cookbook (6) Other items: Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear , Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear , Cerulean Hidden Tear Melee Users Romina, Saint of the Bud , is a mid-sized boss with a body that combines features of a centipede, scorpion, butterfly, and human. She wields a poleblade, centipede fangs, and a scorpion stinger, making her a distinctive opponent. To defeat Romina, you need a balanced strategy of offense and defense, but being more aggressive is often advantageous. When fighting her as a melee character, focus on her central human body as well as her centipede fangs and scorpion stinger, which act as her arms. These parts move independently, allowing her to launch multiple simultaneous attacks, such as swinging her spear while her stinger strikes from another direction. Her attacks include Heavy Spear Thrusts , Sweeping Stinger strikes, and Biting Fangs . Romina’s common opening move is the Centipede Sweep , where her centipede body swings from right to left. You can dodge this by rolling forward just before it hits. This allows you to get close and deliver a full heavy attack. Be aware that she may follow up with a Quick Dash to reposition and swing her poleblade. This can be avoided by rolling to your left or backward. Stay as close as possible to Romina, as some of her sweep attacks won't hit you at point-blank range. Being near her also makes her attack pattern more predictable. For instance, after her usual opening attack, closing the distance with a dodge roll will cause her follow-up attack to miss if you are right beside her. One thing that you should do is to always look at her Poleblade , when you see it glowing red, this means that the weapon is enchanted with Scarlet Rot. If this weapon hits you while the enchantment is active, it will cause Scarlet Rot build-up. So always be wary of her weapon status . One of the combos that she does with her enchanted weapon, is the Leap Combo where she starts with a poleblade sweep, an overhead attack, and then she jumps high in the air, and then plunges her weapon down. To dodge this move you will do the following: Roll to your left for the sweep attack Roll forward (slightly to your right) as she swings the overhead attack Pause here and pay attention when her weapon flashes pink for a brief moment, then roll forward at that exact moment When this move is dodged properly, you can get a couple of free hits as she recovers. This move also has a variation where she would skip the 3rd part of the attack and will just do an enchanted weapon combo. She also has another basic move where she makes 3 quick sweeping movements with her poleblade without enchantments. Then finally, she can also do the Rolling Attack where Romina will curl up into a ball, and then roll around the arena. After she is done rolling, she will then slam the ground and do a swing with her poleblade. You can avoid the initial roll by getting out of her way by either dodging or sprinting away. Lock the camera onto her to see where she is going. At the end of the roll, dodge roll to the right to dodge both of her attacks. Then, you can retaliate with a heavy attack. After she finishes a combo, quickly counterattack to take advantage of the brief windows of vulnerability. Her attacks, while powerful, have high recovery times, allowing you to dodge and immediately counter. When she begins a combo, dodge her attacks by rolling to the side or towards her to close the distance. Immediately after dodging, counter with heavy attacks to break her poise. Frequent usage of jumping and heavy attacks is recommended as it can stagger her, leaving her open to further attacks. One of her special moves is the Double Spin 360 Combo . This is a move where you see her lift her human body up as her weapon glows red, then, she will do 2 full spins while swinging her poleblade. Then, she pauses after this move to recover. This move can be dodged by rolling to the left, then dodging to the left again after a slight delay. This move usually causes Romina to end up at a far position from you, but she will take time to recover and you can do at least 1 light attack or a jump attack if you sprint up to her. During Phase 2, her attacks remain the same but she can now conjure butterflies that will explode after a short period. She will transition into the 2nd Phase when her health drops to 50%, and you will see her surround herself with pink lighting with butterflies circling her. After a brief per

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Romina, Saint of the Bud
sections.text: Blue Dancer Charm A cloth doll depicting a dancer garbed in blue. ' An ancient heirloom of some sort. Raises attack power with lower equipment load. The dancer in blue represents a fairy, who in legend bestowed a flowing sword upon a blind swordsman. Blade in hand, the ' swordsman sealed away an ancient god — a god that was Rot itself. Hefty Rot Pot Craftable item prepared using a capacious cracked pot. A cocktail of rotten materials is sealed inside. Throw at enemies to cause a large buildup of scarlet rot. Rot is one of the divine elements of the outer gods, and eats away at life like a vicious plague. Kindred of Rot Ashes Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit of the Kindred of Rot. This spirit takes the form of a crawling pest, its chitinous body making a dry rustling sound. Attacks enemies by secreting sticky threads. The Kindred of Rot are the servants of the Goddess of Rot—servants that have been forsaken. Map (Lake of Rot) Map of Lake of Rot and environs. A great lake of standing water downstream of the Ainsel River. It is said that the divine essence of an outer god is sealed away in this land. Pest Threads Incantation of the servants of rot. Secretes countless sticky threads, launching them forwards. A technique of the pale pests who crawl through the lands afflicted by scarlet rot; the abandoned children of the goddess. "Do you have an interest in rot incantations?" Pest-Thread Spears Skill of the pests known as the Kindred of Rot, now wielded as an incantation. Secrete numerous sticky threads, then twist them into two spears launched frontwards. Charge to enhance potency. The pests are abandoned servants, and it is for this reason that they found a mother in the Saint of the Bud. Poison Armament Incantation of the servants of rot. Enchants armament held in the right hand with poison. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well. The death that begets life, that comes to all equally. That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice. Poleblade of the Bud Weapon of Romina, Saint of the Bud. A scarlet glaive with a dangling bud-like blade. Attacks cause buildup of rot. Once, in the crumbling, burning church, Romina held the bud in speechless silence. That bud would become her blade. Remembrance of the Rot Goddess Remembrance of Malenia, Goddess of Rot, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. ' Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Miquella and Malenia are both the children of a single god. As such they are both Empyreans, but suffered afflictions from birth. One was cursed with eternal childhood, and the other harbored rot within. Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud Remembrance of Romina, Saint of the Bud, hewn into the Scadutree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. ' Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. After the church was burned to the ground, Romina discovered a ' twisted divine element, which she weaved into the baleful scarlet ' rot. Perhaps then, the buds might find somewhere to gain purchase ' once more, within the scorched remains. Rotten Butterflies Incantation used by Romina, Saint of the Bud. Summons a myriad of butterflies while performing a gentle twirl. The butterflies break apart on contact, scattering rot and setting off a chain reaction. The scarlet butterflies are as the Goddess of Rot's wings. Bereft of a master, they were soothed by Romina, who reached out to them. Scarlet Aeonia Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot. Creates a gigantic flower that blooms into an explosion of scarlet rot. Each time the scarlet flower blooms, Malenia's rot advances. It has bloomed twice already. With the third bloom, she will become a true goddess. Scarlet Bud A large, rotten bud that will never come into bloom. Material used for crafting items. Grows in lands blighted by the scarlet rot. There was a time when these buds were not touched by the scarlet rot's blight—when they were the symbol of the small church deep in the ancient ruins of Rauh. Scorpion's Stinger Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot. A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god. Spider Scorpion Ashes Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a spider scorpion. This scorpion is larger than a human, and attacks with pincers and a poisonous tail. Appears some distance from the summoner. This breed of scorpion was native to the realm of shadow, but was far smaller in size. Recent giant scorpions are said to trace back to the Church of the Bud.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Boss Guide
sections.text: Roundtable Knight Vyke Boss Video Guide Roundtable Knight Vyke Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Vyke : His Dragonbolt buff also lowers his Lightning Defense by around 35%, so use any weapons that deal Lightning Damage. For faith, Lightning Spear , Lightning Fortification , and Flame of Frenzy . Inescapable Frenzy , while extremely risky to use, can deal a lot of damage if it lands. For intelligence, Stars of Ruin or Star Shower , Night Comet , Gavel of Haima , Adula's Moonblade . Suggested items: Boltdrake Talisman and Lightningproof Dried Liver for lightning resistance, Boiled Crab and Pickled Turtle Neck for defense and stamina recovery. Melee Users One main thing to note when facing Vyke is that while he mainly uses lightning, he also weak to it. You can come prepared with a few options: Boltdrake Talismanwill have the ability to boost Lightning Damage negation while the Lightning Scorpion Charm raises Lightning Damage , but lowers damage negation. With neither of those items on hand, there is a consumable that would also temporarily boost lightning negation. Lightningproof Dried Liver can easily be Crafted or found from a few locations in Leyndell Royal Capital and Altus Plateau . Users also recommend a Faith Lightning Spear since his buff makes him vulnerable to lightning and he can be easily staggered due to his low poise. When facing Vyke, watch for his Storm Assault and Fortissax’s Lightning Spear. He can inflict additional lightning damage with his melee attacks when he buffed himself with the Lightning buff. There will be a short period as he buffs himself that would give players an opening to strike. Be aware of these openings and quickly back away as the action ends because he will immediately follow up with a few of his lightning attacks. This will give you space to avoid them. After using his spells, he may sometimes run towards you to close the distance which will give you an opportunity to reposition or even charge at him. Most of his melee actions are quick with a short range so you can easily roll back away from them and follow up with an attack as well. If you happen to have a shield and are too close to avoid his charge attack, you can instead, guard counter this action. Continue with a combination of avoiding his lightning strikes, rolling back away from his melee attacks then charging forward in between attacks to eventually clear his HP. Magic and Ranged Users When you prepare to face him, be aware that his main attacks and weaknesses are both to lightning. You may equip the relevant talismans to boost lightning negation or damage such as the Boltdrake Talismanwhich will have the ability to boost Lightning Damage negation or the Lightning Scorpion Charm which raises Lightning Damage but lowers damage negation. Lightningproof Dried Liver will also be able to boost lightning negation. With magic, you can use the large arena to your advantage. In the Evergaol, circle around him and continuously use your ranged attacks such as Rock Sling since he staggers easily. Night Comet is also said to be effective against him and his quick dodges. It can also be used to interrupt his heals. Avoid attempting to afflict any Status Effects on him since he is immune. He will begin with a set of melee attacks until you see his charge-up animation which opens him up to use his lightning attacks. Create some distance and he will be forced to give chase in order to deal his melee charge attacks. During this time, you can attempt to deal more attacks from a distance while continuously repositioning yourself to deplete his HP. Roundtable Knight Vyke Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Storm Assault Vyke channels a gust of wind around him, leaping into the air and plunging his spear into the ground, dealing massive damage, if not outright killing players instantly. This is easily his most dangerous move, as he often tends to use it while being attacked at close-range. Vyke gains immense hyper-armor while using this skill, so it's best not to engage it directly. Heavier weapons can knock him out of this attack. Lightning Strike At a distance, Vyke fires off a bolt into the air, causing lightning to strike in a wide area directly in front of him. He can repeatedly cast this spell several times. If you see yellow sparks on the ground, dodge or run to the sides immediately. As he tends to repeatedly use this spell, you can also run in to interrupt it. Vyke’s Dragonbolt Vyke calls down a bolt of red lightning, coating both his body and weapon. This grants him a 15% increased Equip Load and buffs his weapon to inflict additional Lightning Damage , at the cost of reducing his Lightning Damage negation by 35%. While this buff may seem dangerous at first, as it buffs his already dangerous melee attacks, his lightning damage negation is lowered as well. Capitalize on the opportunity with lightning spells and throwing pots. Fortissax's Lightning Spear Vyke leaps into the air and creates two bolts of red lightn

sections.heading: Roundtable Knight Vyke Notes & Trivia
sections.text: Vyke appears on Elden Ring's cover art, kneeling down and holding a sword. He wields a unique variant of his signature War Spear that lacks Fire Damage, has a different skill, and uses the same strong attack as the Lance and Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear . Defeating this boss does NOT prevent the invader from appearing. In the 1.00 version of the game, he was named Vyke the Dragonspear .

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Roundtable Knight Vyke
sections.text: Vyke's Dragonbolt Incantation of Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. Summons red lightning to bolster both the caster's body and their armament held in the right hand. Enchants armaments with lightning-affinity attacks and increases maximum equipment load. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced. Of all the knights, Vyke the Dragonspear was the one Lansseax loved the most. Fingerprint Armor Iron armor singed and blistered by fingers. ' Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion? Vyke's War Spear War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold. Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within. sections.heading: Elden Ring Royal Knight Loretta Boss Guide
sections.text: Royal Knight Loretta Boss Video Guide Royal Knight Loretta Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Royal Knight Loretta: Maintain your distance when she uses glintstone sorceries Use Spelldrake Talisman and/or Magic Fortification to minimize damage from magical attacks Distract her with a spirit with lots of health and high Magic resistance such as Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes Use Lightning Spear to take advantage of her elemental weakness Melee Users Hit Heavy: Take advantage of Loretta's relatively low stance to get in jump attacks and charged heavy attacks. Learn one or two of her attacks that you can consistently dodge and punish, and you'll be able to reliably stagger her. Use these staggers to get in more charged heavy attacks. Box Her In: Try to draw Loretta over to the confined area up the stairs to the left as you enter the arena. The central edifice can be used for cover against attacks, especially when healing. Meanwhile, Loretta's movement will be limited which will help keep her at melee range. Incom-parry-ble: Loretta's parry timings are relatively easy to learn, especially for her Leap Attack which you can bait out by maintaining a medium distance from her when dodging her spells. Although you can't get in a critical hit after a parry, you can use that time to get in plenty of damage. Magic and Ranged Users Keep Your Distance: There's no need to spend any more time near Loretta than absolutely necessary as a ranged user. Once you're far away, you're safe from most of her melee attacks and you'll have time to get in attacks while she's casting Glintblade Phalanx or repositioning herself. Royal Knight Loretta Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Side Swing Swings her sickle in various directions, usually on her right flank Rolling into her horizontal sweeps and under her diagonal swings will usually position you towards the front or back of the horse, which will give you a chance to get in a hit before the next attack or during a Glintblade Phalanx Stab Stabs the blade of her sickle in various directions Roll perpendicular to the direction of the sickle Rearing Swing Rears up, then slams her sickle down diagonally to her right Get in a hit while the horse is rearing, then roll to your right to avoid the swing Bash Swing Her steed steps back and to her left, then bashes its head forward as she swings her sickle clockwise Roll towards her right flank when the horse's right hoof rises from the ground to move through the bash and avoid the swing Hoof Attack Her steed rears up, then slams down its hooves Get in a hit while the horse is rearing, then roll to either side Kick Her steed's tail rises briefly before it lashes out with its hind legs. Only used if you're behind her horse Roll in any direction as soon as you notice the attack Leap Attack Jumps towards you and swings her sickle clockwise as she lands. Usually uses this when you're a medium distance away Roll in the direction she's moving to minimize the chance the halberd will hit you and position yourself to attack after she lands Leap Duo Swings her sickle counterclockwise and jumps forward as she finishes the swing, then swings clockwise as she lands, finally turning 90° counterclockwise. Only used below 80% HP. Only the second swing is parriable Roll away to avoid both swings Glintblade Phalanx Her polearm glows blue as she swings it around her head and summons 5 glintblades which fly at you after a short delay. May leap back while casting if you're close Phase 2: Summons 3 additional glintblades that fire shortly after the first set Keep moving around her and the glintblades will miss you, especially if you're further away. Don't try to attack until they're gone. You may be able to get in a hit when she begins to summon the glintblades, but be prepared for her to quickly combo into another attack Glintstone Star Fires a single magical projectile from the butt of her sickle. May leap back while casting if you're close Phase 2: Fires 5 projectiles instead If you're far away, circle her and the projectiles will miss you. If you're close, roll forward through them Phase 2 Phase Transition Once she's below 50% health, raises her shield above her head and creates a large seal of the Carian royal family This move doesn't do damage, so keep track of her health and be prepared to take advantage of this to get in free damage Loretta's Greatbow Summons a magical greatbow, pulls back a giant magical arrow, and shoots it. The arrow explodes on impact and deals immense damage. May leap back while casting if you're close Roll directly towards her once you see the arrow in flight. If she jumps while firing, you can dodge just by running towards her : Attack can be parried : Attack can be spell parried Royal Knight Loretta Notes & Other Trivia This version of Loretta appears to be a spiritual guardian, protecting Ranni from trespassers. Due to her status as a former Carian Knight, it’s safe to assume so. According to the item description of the Silver Mir

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Royal Knight Loretta
sections.text: Royal Knight Armor Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta was once a royal Carian Knight, and her lapis-lazuli blue cape is the emblem of the knightly pride that continues to guide her. Royal Knight Helm Silver helm of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation' . Loretta's War Sickle Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold. Loretta's Greatbow Sorcery used by Royal Knight Loretta. Creates a magic greatbow and fires a great arrow. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrow nocked. It is said that the bow was Loretta's favored weapon. Loretta's Mastery Sorcery used by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Creates a magic greatbow and fires four great arrows simultaneously. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrows nocked. Developed by Loretta after her long, bloody journey to seek out a place where the Albinaurics could live in peace. Silver Mirrorshield Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. The shape is said to imitate that of a sacred drop of dew, which inspired the absurd rumor that Loretta herself was an Albinauric' .

sections.heading: Elden Ring Royal Revenant Boss Guide
sections.text: Royal Revenant Boss Video Guide Royal Revenant Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Royal Revenant: Use Heal for massive damage Any starting class can use this spell by equipping Two Fingers Heirloom and, for the Prisoner , Commoner's Simple Garb Use Barricade Shield to block its attacks and get in guard counters Melee Users Bait and Break: Use a heavier weapon and focus on breaking its stance with jumping attacks, charged heavy attacks, or guard counters. Keep your distance from the Royal Revenant, and circle it to avoid its many lunging attacks. When it does lunge, dodge forward and to the side and use the time it takes for it to rotate to get in a substantial hit. Consider bringing a weapon with high critical damage, like Misericorde , to take full advantage of the stance breaks. Magic and Ranged Users The Healing Blow: Immediately cast Heal as the Royal Revenant first crawls out the ground. This will break its stance, but rather than getting a critical hit just cast Heal again to finish it off. The Great Circle: Keep circling the revenant and backing away. It's easier to dodge its distance-closing attacks, and this should give you time to get off regular attacks. Royal Revenant Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Swing Lunges forward a small distance and swings the arms on one side in one direction or another Roll in the same direction as its swing to avoid getting hit by its back arms Jumping Swing Pulls back its right arms, then jumps forward Roll forward and to your left through its swinging arms, then turn and attack it Retreating Swing Pivots 270° and swings its arms in the direction it's turning, then scrambles backwards Roll backwards once you see it begin to pivot Quick Slam Move forward a small distance and slams its many hands down in front of it Roll forward and to either side, then turn and attack it Rearing Slam Rears back, then lunges forward and slams its many hands down in front of it Roll to either side once you see it begin to fall Twisting Leap Jumps forward with its arms raised, then swipes them clockwise at you and it passes by, finally turning its body 180° as it lands As it leaves the ground, roll away perpendicular to its direction of movement Wild Swings Scrambles forward, swinging its arms wildly Roll to either side, then follow it and prepare to strike once it's finished moving Poison Gout Shoots a stream of poison forward that coats the floor for a time Roll to either side Portal Teleport Opens a glowing portal in the ground and crawls into it, then crawls out again elsewhere in the arena Scan the arena to try to see where it's emerging, and stick close to walls to limit your blind spots. Once you see it climbing out, try to move to its sides to get in an attack Sidestep Teleport Steps to one side or another, vanishes, then reappears a short distance further Prepare to dodge the follow-up attack Royal Revenant Lore, Notes & Other Trivia Healing incantations damage it. Heal , Great Heal , Lord's Heal and Erdtree Heal all hurt the Revenant instead of healing it, which is the fastest way to end the fight for a Faith build. Slash negation is -10, so slashing weapons land 10% harder than normal. Holy is its best defense at 40 and should be avoided. Every other damage type sits at 0 negation, so there is no bad physical or elemental choice besides Holy. It hides in a sealed room beneath the Kingsrealm Ruins in northwest Liurnia of the Lakes ; the stairs are behind an illusory floor in the northeast of the ruins that dispels when attacked or rolled over. 3,077 HP against 107 defense, with only 70 Stance — it breaks quickly despite not being parryable . It is immune to Sleep and Madness , but open to every other status effect.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Rugalea the Great Red Bear Boss Guide
sections.text: Rugalea the Great Red Bear Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] Shadow of the Erdtree Bosses Ranked Rugalea the Great Red Bear Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Rugalea the Great Red Bear: Use the ?? Ash Summons Use the ?? Spell Bring Sleep Pot , Eternal Sleep Pot Rugalea the Great Red Bear is a boss that can spawn with "Golden Eyes" and makes it drop 5x more Runes (over 1,500,000). This effect is random. Melee Users Rugalea the Great Red Bear can be found in the northern area of the Rauh Base . From the Ravine North Site of Grace , follow the river on the west and head into the forest on the right. This boss deals Standard , Slash , and Strike damages. Rugalea only has a few attacks, with one having another variant. Rugalea has a Single-fist Ground Burst and a Double-Fist Ground burst . During this move, the boss will dig one or both claws into the ground and throw rocks in your direction as it lifts its paws upward. This attack can be indicated when it readies one claw or both claws to dig into the ground. This attack creates an AoE that affects the area around it, and so the recommended way to avoid this attack is to dodge to either side. Another claw attack it does is its Slashes , it will rise up and swing both its claws at you one at a time, this attack can be indicated when Rugalea stands up on its hind legs and pulls its forelegs back before attacking. You can dodge back with each swing to avoid this attack. This boss has 2 other attacks, one of which is its Body slam . This is where Rugalea rises up and slams down on its belly. This attack can be indicated when Rugalea rises up, and lands on its front paws briefly after. You can dodge back or to the sides to avoid this attack. The last attack Rugalea has is its Mighty Roar , it will stand on its back legs and let out a mighty roar that knocks you down. When you see Rugalea rise on its back legs and not go back down, you will need to dodge by rolling forward and get behind it to avoid the attack. When Rugalea the Great Red Bear is defeated, it will drop 210,000 Runes and the Roar of Rugalea . Magic and Ranged Users Strategy Writeup for Magic Users Rugalea the Great Red Bear Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Single Fist Ground Burst Rugalea will dig one of its claws into the ground and throw rocks in your direction. You can dodge out the range of the ground attack to avoid getting hit by the rocks. Double Fist Ground Burst Rugalea will dig both of its claws into the ground and throw rocks in your direction. You will need to dodge out of the way of the flying rocks to avoid getting hit by the attack as the attack will cover a larger AoE than the previous one. Slashes Rugalea lifts up each paw before swinging it at you. With each swing, you will need to dodge to the side to avoid the attack. Body Slam Rugalea rises up and then lands on its front paws before slamming down on its belly. You can dodge backward when you see it rise up to avoid the body slam attack. Mighty Roar Rugalea will rise up to perform a mighty roar that will knock you down. When you see Rugalea rise up with open arms, you can dodge and get behind him to avoid getting knocked down. Rugalea the Great Red Bear Notes & Other Trivia Despite being a boss, Rugalea can have the "golden eye" status and give extra runes when killed

sections.heading: Elden Ring Runebear Boss Guide
sections.text: Runebear Boss Video Guide Runebear Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Runebear: Use the Lone Wolf Ashes If you see the Runebear winding up for his grab, hug his left leg and roll with it. Stay close to the Runebear and roll into its attacks Melee Users Keep to the Belly: Try to stay underneath the Runebear. Dodge through its attacks and attack back as hard as you can, dodging forward whenever it swings or rises on its hind legs. Most of its attacks will pass over you, giving you plenty of time to deal damage. Blocking is risky since its attacks do massive Stamina damage. Break its Stance: Although the Runebear has relatively high Stance , once it breaks it'll be knocked out for long enough to get in a few attacks and a critical hit . This may make it worthwhile to use charged heavy attacks, jump attacks, or other means of dealing lots of stance damage. Magic and Ranged Users Since the Runebear is safest up close, your best bet as a spellcaster is to use short-range spells and follow the same strategy as melee players. Bow users who are unwilling to switch to melee will have quite a challenge. Use a Shortbow for its attack speed and fire arrows at point-blank range. Runebear Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Claw Maul Raises its claw and slashes it forward. This attack has a deceptively large hitbox and excellent tracking If you're underneath the Runebear, this attack will miss. Otherwise, dodge in when the paw reaches the top its arc Smash Rises briefly onto its hind legs with its left paw raised, then slams it into the ground This attack has limited range, so back away or move around the back of the Runebear Bite The bear opens its mouth and lunges forward Roll into the bear, trying to end up in the safer area underneath it Lunge Leaps through the air towards its target, covering a lot of distance Roll into the bear, trying to end up in the safer area underneath it Charge Ducks down and charges forward. This attack has nearly no windup and covers a significant distance. This is the most unpredictable attack. Once you see the bear turn around, prepare to dodge to the sides, otherwise try and block. Double Paw Smash Rises onto its hind legs with both paws raised, then slams them both into the ground creating a shockwave If you've got some distance, you can jump over the shockwave. Otherwise, roll in once its paws are level with its face Bear Hug Rises onto its hind legs with its arms spread wide, walks forward a bit, and grabs you with both arms Roll once it's taken a few steps, or simply run away. If you get grabbed, mash buttons to free yourself quicker. Beast's roar The Runbear fires off a sonic projectile from its mouth. Commonly used at a distance Dodge or block the attack. If you're up close, it will use this attack less frequently. Runebear Lore, Notes & Other Trivia A bug may occur when the Runebear grabs the player. If they manage to escape by mashing, the boss may fall through the floor and instantly die. Runebear Combo Chart

sections.heading: Elden Ring God-Devouring Serpent / Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Boss Guide
sections.text: God-Devouring Serpent Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy God-Devouring Serpent Boss Video Guide [video coming soon] God-Devouring Serpent Fight Strategy The Best Tips for God-Devouring Serpent: Use the Serpent-Hunter Great Spear found at the beginning of the boss' chamber. Check your equipment load (to avoid fat-rolling) after equipping the spear; it's heavy! Use the Mimic Tear Spirit Summon while equipped with the Serpent-Hunter to significantly reduce the boss' difficulty. General Strategy Be sure to pick up the Serpent-Hunter Great Spear from the corpse at the start of the boss chamber. This weapon manifests a blade of light with each attack, significantly extending its range and allowing you to hit both phases of the boss from outside the magma pool. The Serpent primarily attacks with lunging strikes and bites. It can also perform a special grab animation where it slams you down twice, though it only deals damage once. Occasionally, the Serpent raises its head and slams its chin onto the ground, sending magma flying in a wide arc. You can dodge roll this or block this attack to minimize damage. If you're using the Serpent-Hunter, consistently poke the Serpent between its attacks. Repeated strikes to its head will briefly stagger the Serpent, giving you a valuable window for uninterrupted attacks. Once the Serpent is defeated, Phase Two begins with Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy . Click on the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy tab here for the strategy for Phase Two. Cheese Strategy The God-Devouring Serpent and by extension, Rykard can be made significantly more easy by summoning the Mimic Tear Spirit while equipped with the Serpent-Hunter . The Mimic copies your current equipment and this extends to the blade of light functionality of the Serpent-Hunter. The Mimic will attack of its own volition and you will still need to dodge the boss' attacks properly but having what is essentially a second player firing blades of light at him will massively cut down the amount of time and effort required to defeat the boss. Melee Users Strategy Writeup for Melee Users If player wants to beat the boss without Serpent-Hunter as a melee, he should focus on inflicting Status-Effects ( Frostbite and Blood loss ). Frozen Antspur Rapier will be the best tool for it, even at +0, Magic and Ranged Users Strategy Writeup for Magic Users If the player wants to beat God-Devouring Serpent without Serpent-Hunter, the optimal spells would be Borealis's Mist & Ekzykes's Decay (Incantation) or Rock Sling (Sorcery) combined with source of Frostbite like Freezing Pots . Beginning of fight gives a good opportunity to apply Status Effect. God-Devouring Serpent Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Snake Bite The Serpent lunges from one side towards you. It will sometimes follow up with a second lunge from the opposite direction. Dodge towards the direction the lunge is coming from. Grab Attack The Serpent raises its head up high and lunges forward. If the attack connects, the snake will grab the player, slamming them twice but dealing damage only once. Requires precise timing to prevent the grab. Poison Spit The Serpent spits several globs of poison that spread out in various directions, leaving a pool of poison on the ground momentarily. Stay within medium range to prevent it from using this move. Do not stand in poison puddles. Magma Slam The Serpent raises its head up high, tilting it to the back. It then slams its chin on the ground, sending magma flying outwards in a very wide arc in front of it. Dodge through the magma or block it to reduce damage. Magma Upheaval The Serpent raises and coils its head on its left and then plunges its face into the ground. After a short delay, it pulls its head from the ground, causing a wide magma eruption that travels forward in front of it. This move is very difficult to dodge but can be blocked with a shield to significantly reduce damage. Magma Thrash The Serpent raises its head up high, looking to the side with its jaws wide open. It then begins thrashing about the magma as it spins around 360 degrees, sweeping with its head and tail, sending magma splashing about in random directions. Maintain your distance and avoid any flying magma. Elden Ring Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Notes & Other Trivia Voice Actor: Simon Gregor WARNING! Defeating Rykard will lock players out of completing any incomplete Volcano Manor invasion requests. Was formerly called Rykard, Recusant Shardbearer in the 1.00 version of the game. World Changes after Defeat: After the encounter with Rykard, you receive the Remembrance of the Blasphemous and you should have Rykard's Great Rune . This can now be activated at the Divine Tower of West Altus . After defeating him, you can return to the main chambers of Volcano Manor and speak to the NPCs . After reloading the area, the NPCs will leave the area, with Bernahl leaving a sword at his seat that you can continue buying his wares off of. At this point, if you teleport back to Rykard's boss ar

sections.heading: Lore Items Related to Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
sections.text: Rykard's Great Rune A Great Rune of the shardbearer Rykard. ' Its blessing restores HP on attacking enemies. Rykard was amongst the children of Rennala and Radagon, who became demigod stepchildren after Radagon's union with Queen Marika. But Rykard fed himself to the blasphemous serpent, Great Rune and all. Serpent-God's Curved Sword Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity ' and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir. Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon ' slaying an enemy. Magma Shot One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir. Fires a lump of magma that explodes on contact. Charging enhances potency. After discovering the ancient hexes of Gelmir, Rykard, son of Queen Rennala, brought them back into practical use as new forms of sorcery. Blasphemous Claw A slab of rock engraved with traces of the Rune of Death. Can deflect the power of the Black Blade. On the night of the dire plot, Ranni rewarded Praetor Rykard with these traces. Should the coming trespass one day transpire, they would serve as a last-resort foil, allowing Rykard to challenge Maliketh the Black Blade, the black beast of Destined Death. Taker's Cameo A talisman engraved with a stern likeness of Praetor Rykard, master of Volcano Manor. Restores HP upon defeating enemies. When Rykard turned to heresy, taking by force became the rule. The gods themselves were no different, after all. Duelist Set Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered. Devourer's Scepter Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This ' weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of ' Blasphemy. ' One of the legendary armaments. A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments ' before being devoured by the great serpent. Gelmir Knight Armor Armor worn by knights once loyal to Praector Rykard. It bears an emblem that none wear any longer, standing as it does for a lord that fell from loft ambition into gluttonous depravity. As the lord lost his dignity, so too did these knights lose their master. Rykard's Rancor The terrible power of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Summons searing spirits that leave a trail of delayed explosions in their wake. These spirits manifest from the rancor of heroes who met a violent end. The lord granted them an audience, whereupon they were welcomed by the maw of the great serpent -- and within the serpent's bowels, they became the lord's kin. Serpent-Hunter Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to ' have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant ' past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere ' greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt ' their lord. Man-Serpent Ashes Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. ' Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent. Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma. ' It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed. Serpent's Amnion Amnion from the mother's womb which cradled the poor unwanted offspring of a repellant birthing ritual. It will never dry out, remaining damp indefinitely. Remembrance of the Blasphemous Remembrance of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, hewn into the ' Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. ' Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Rykard took the form of a giant serpent that he might devour, grow, and live eternally. "I understand. The road of blasphemy is long and perilous. One cannot walk it unprepared to sin." Tonic of Forgetfulness Tonic in a small brass vial. Banishes distress and bitter memories. A gift bestowed by Rykard, sworn to blasphemy, to Lady Tanith, who unfortunately had no use for it. "My Lord, there could be no greater distress than to forget you." Consort's Set Long ago, when Rykard first set eyes on Tanith, she was working as a dancer in a foreign land. Soon, he made her his consort. She was the only human to remain by his side when he became the serpent of blasphemy. In that moment, Tanith was truly charmed by him.

sections.heading: Dialogue Related to Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
sections.text: Gideon Ofnir Praetor Rykard is the Lord of the Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir. He is a ruthless justiciar who commands a company of inquisitors, reviled for his serpentine demeanour. The volcano, Mt. Gelmir, lies in the west of the Altus Plateau; the realm of the Erdtree. It was the stage of the most appalling battle in the entirety of the Shattering. Lady Tanith If the Erdtree, and indeed the very gods, would debase us so, then we are willing to raise the banner of resistance, even if it means heresy. We at the Volcano Manor, under Lord Rykard, have sworn no rest until it is done. If you follow this heroic path, one day the Lord will see you. The Lord's visits with our champions are always a spectacle. It cannot come a day too soon! You... It's true then. You've defeated out Lord. No, I must thank you. Our Lord was yet weak. You have taught us that. Defeat is not the end. Our Lord is immortal, and will one day rise again, stronger. Until then, I must stay the path, and do my part. Oh, you... Allow me some time. Our lord's carcass is vast and not easily consumed. Dear Rykard, please find purchase within me, I wish to be your serpent; your family. One day, let us devour the gods together. Recusant Bernahl So. You killed Rykard? I harbour you no ill will. The strong take. Such is our code. Even he was prepared to meet a wretched end when he first took blasphemy unto his very flesh. But anyroad, the Volcano Manor is no more. Though we may yet fulfil an old promise. We hunted our own kind, and took what was theirs. And with everything in hand, the time has come to rise, against the Erdtree. O Greater Will, hear my voice. I am the recusant Bernahl, inheritor of my brother's will, and you will fall to my blade. We refuse to become your pawns. Consider this fair warning.

sections.heading: Elden Ring Sanguine Noble Boss Guide
sections.text: Sanguine Noble Fight Strategy The Best Tips for Sanguine Noble: Bring Stanching Boluses Item Melee Users For melee users, be wary as the Sanguine Noble's swings are very fast, so it's recommended that you use a fast one-hand weapon like a straight sword or an axe. Every single type of attack this boss does stacks bleed so it's best that you bring Stanching Boluses . Do not rush this boss and be careful with its string of stabs and slashes. Also be wary of its stance where you see the dagger on its left hand being lifted, it means it's ready to parry your incoming attacks. Do not engage in melee when you see this stance, as it will most likely parry you successfully once you try to attack. A successful parry on you will get you stabbed and also build-up your bleed meter very quickly. Magic and Ranged Users For magic and ranged users, it's recommended that you equip a heavy hitting spell/incantation or weapon for ranged attacks to quickly finish the Sanguine Noble. Just be careful with the blood puddles and the dagger throw as those are also the boss' ranged options. You should also look out for the leaping thrust where it leaps forward and thrusts its sword, this move quickly closes the gap when you're trying to create distance or when you're far away from the boss for too long. Sanguine Noble Attacks & Counters Attack Description Counter Blood Puddles Slashes the ground, leaving blood puddles in the area. Touching the blood puddles will build-up your bleed meter. You will clearly see the blood puddles on the ground, stepping on them will build up your bleed meter so avoid them at all costs. Dagger Parry Raises the dagger in its left hand, waiting for an attack. If it successfully parries you, you will get a frontal stab that deals massive damage, and also stack up your bleed meter very quickly. When you see the dagger being lifted up or you see a different stance, do not engage in melee, because the parry will most likely connect, and you will be stabbed, which deals massive damage. You can engage in magic or ranged attack. Dagger Throw Uses the dagger on its left hand as a projectile and throws it towards you. When you create distance, be ready to dodge roll as well since the dagger throw is the ranged option for this boss. Leaping Thrust Leaps forward, closing the gap and thrusts its sword. Can be followed up by other attacks afterwards. This is one of the boss' attacks that will quickly close the gap when you try to create distance or if you're far away for to long. It is recommended that you just dodge roll backwards or away from this attack as it can follow up with a different attack after the initial thrust. Sanguine Noble Lore, Notes & Other Trivia Voice Actor: ?? Sanguine Noble can easily be staggered. All their attacks have bleed.
